title: Anon could enumerate every user's media files
symptom: A signed-out user could list('') the media bucket and enumerate all users' folders and files.
root_cause: The storage SELECT policy allowed anon to list the whole bucket.
fix: Migration lock_media_bucket_select_to_own_folder scoped SELECT to authenticated users and their own folder; verified playback still works.

title: Anthropic API key survived account switch (next user bills previous)
symptom: After switching accounts on a shared device, the previous user's saved Anthropic API key persisted, so the next user's AI actions would silently bill the previous user.
root_cause: The stored API key was not scoped or cleared on account switch, unlike other per-account local content.
fix: Cleared/scoped the API key on account switch so it no longer survives into the next user's session.

title: Could not post multiple / photo stories
symptom: Posting more than one story (specifically photo stories) failed with 'new row violates row-level security policy'.
root_cause: A storage RLS issue on the media bucket blocked the upsert for photo stories (text-only worked).
fix: Added an additive own-folder UPDATE policy on storage so photo/multi stories post.

title: Cross-account local data leak on shared device
symptom: Signing into a second account on the same device exposed the first account's countdowns, notes, trackers and voice notes.
root_cause: Local content was stored device-globally with no per-account scoping; the reset flow leaked the same way.
fix: Added accountScope.ts to stamp finished.owner-uid on sign-in, wipe on switch, and made push/pull re-check ownership so a race can't cross accounts; cleaned the leaked rows.

title: Cross-user data leak on account switch
symptom: After switching accounts locally, a user saw another user's celebration countdowns.
root_cause: signOut() did not wipe local user data and account-switch left stale React state.
fix: Sign-out now wipes all local user content and Switch account hard-reloads; committed as a P0 fix.

title: Dangerous RPCs callable from client
symptom: Privileged operations read_vault_secret and add_credits were reachable from the client.
root_cause: Sensitive server functions were exposed to the client surface.
fix: Removed them so read_vault_secret and add_credits no longer appear/are callable.

title: Database SECURITY DEFINER / search_path hardening
symptom: SECURITY DEFINER views bypassed RLS and could re-leak protected tables, and functions had mutable search_path; some policies trusted user-editable user_metadata.
root_cause: Advisor lints 0010 (definer views) and 0015 (user_metadata policies) plus mutable search_path across functions.
fix: Locked down the SECURITY DEFINER surface, fixed the mutable search_path across functions, and stopped trusting user_metadata.

title: Deleting posts/stories orphaned uploaded media
symptom: Deleting a post or story left its photo/video fetchable by URL forever, and avatar changes orphaned the old file.
root_cause: deletePost/deleteStory removed only the DB row, not the storage file.
fix: Delete now also removes the associated storage file; verified.

title: Email column readable via profiles
symptom: The profiles table exposed users' email addresses.
root_cause: No column-level restriction on the profiles select surface.
fix: Applied column-level grants so only id, handle, full_name, avatar_url, bio, plan are readable; selecting email now returns permission denied.

title: email_for_handle revoke left a silent PUBLIC ACL hole
symptom: A Postgres function remained accessible to PUBLIC despite a revoke.
root_cause: The staged email_for_handle revoke omitted PUBLIC from the ACL.
fix: Revoked PUBLIC live and fixed the staged migration to include PUBLIC.

title: Missing CSP and security headers
symptom: The app shipped with no Content-Security-Policy or security headers.
root_cause: An inline boot script prevented a strict script-src 'self' policy.
fix: Externalized the boot script to /boot.js and added a strict CSP plus security headers.

title: Private 'Only me' posts leaked to friends
symptom: Posts set to private were visible to friends.
root_cause: The RLS friends branch checked is_friend regardless of the post's audience.
fix: Tightened the RLS policy so private posts are author-only.

title: Source files leaked over HTTP
symptom: `/package.json`, `/vite.config.ts`, `/src/*` and other repo files were served as real files.
root_cause: The broken Pages config served the repo root instead of the SPA build.
fix: With the build config fixed, those paths now fall through to the SPA shell (text/html) instead of leaking source.

title: Stale tab survives account switch and re-uploads data
symptom: A second open tab that survived an account switch could re-save and re-upload the previous user's data.
root_cause: The old tab kept the previous account's in-memory state after the switch.
fix: Closed this cross-account leak path so a surviving tab can't re-upload old data.

title: Stripe webhook rejected all payments (Verify JWT on)
symptom: Billing was dead; every paying customer got no credits or subscription.
root_cause: stripe-webhook had Verify JWT ON, so Stripe's signature-carrying webhooks were rejected with 401 before reaching the code.
fix: Turned verify_jwt off so the webhook reaches the code and verifies the Stripe signature (verified 401 became 400).

title: Unauthenticated translate endpoint abuse
symptom: Anyone could hammer the pre-login translate endpoint with 640K chars per request, risking runaway cost.
root_cause: The endpoint ran before login with no rate limit and no size cap.
fix: Added a hard total-chars-per-request cap plus per-IP rate limiting; deployed and verified live.

title: Deleted celebrations resurrect
symptom: Deleted celebrations could reappear after the new sync engine ran.
root_cause: The new sync engine lacked deletion handling for these records.
fix: Fixed the related sync flaw so deletions persist.

title: Deleting a recording did not unshare or remove the file
symptom: Deleting a recording left the shared row and cloud file fetchable.
root_cause: deleteRecording only removed the local row.
fix: unshareRecording() now deletes the recordings row and the stored cloud file.

title: Deletions resurrect in synced IndexedDB stores
symptom: Deletions across seven synced IndexedDB stores (docs, flashcards, memos, homework, trackers, snips, book notes) reappeared within ~25 seconds.
root_cause: Only localStorage stores had tombstones, so IndexedDB deletions were re-pulled from the cloud.
fix: Added tombstones to the IndexedDB stores so deletions stick.

title: Recording lost on crash or full disk
symptom: When the disk filled or the tab crashed/OOMed, the entire recording was lost.
root_cause: Chunks were held in an in-memory array flushed only at stop time.
fix: Journal each ~1s chunk to IndexedDB as it's captured and assemble on save (crash-proof).

title: Recordings local-only by default risked loss
symptom: A lost device meant lost video because recordings stayed local.
root_cause: streamCloud defaulted to false, framed as a niche storage-saver.
fix: Cloud streaming now defaults ON when signed in.

title: Seed calendar has self-overlapping event
symptom: A conflict flagged 'Standup overlaps Standup'.
root_cause: The seed data created a duplicate overlapping event.
fix: Fixed the seed data.

title: Stale device overwrites newer cloud journal notes
symptom: A stale device could silently overwrite newer journal notes in the cloud, and concurrent syncs could interleave.
root_cause: Re-sync wrote unchanged content back over newer cloud data with no change detection or serialization.
fix: Hash-skip unchanged journals on re-sync (no stale clobber) and guarded concurrent syncs.

title: Broken main build referencing SignInLoader before it existed
symptom: App.tsx referenced SignInLoader which was never created, leaving main with a broken build.
root_cause: A concurrent edit committed the reference before the component file existed.
fix: Created the branded sign-in loader component to restore a green build.

title: Calendar crashes on unrecognised event kind
symptom: Any event kind the calendar did not recognise took down the whole calendar view.
root_cause: calendar.js indexed KINDS[e.kind].color directly with no guard for unknown kinds.
fix: Guarded the KINDS lookup so unknown event kinds no longer crash the view.

title: Deployed app stuck on blank/loading screen on Cloudflare
symptom: The Cloudflare-hosted app and custom domain showed only a blank/continuous loading screen; localhost worked.
root_cause: A stale/poisoned service worker served an old index.html pointing at asset hashes that no longer exist, and sw.js was cacheable so the kill-switch never loaded.
fix: Forced sw.js/index.html to never cache, added a kill-switch SW that self-unregisters, an inline boot-script SW purge, an error boundary, and SPA _redirects.

title: Library crash on malformed record
symptom: Library.tsx crashed calling .slice on undefined while mapping records missing a title.
root_cause: A record missing the title field wasn't guarded against.
fix: Added a defensive guard at the crash point to harden Library against malformed records.

title: PDF cover render hang
symptom: Loading a PDF whose fonts can't render to canvas hung the app on cover generation.
root_cause: Cover render blocked when embedded fonts couldn't rasterize.
fix: Added useSystemFonts:true plus a cover-render timeout race, falling back to a monogram cover.

title: Split React import
symptom: A split/duplicated React import broke the build for the new UI bits.
root_cause: React was imported in two conflicting statements.
fix: Fixed the split React import and added the needed CSS.

title: Study page missing i18n import
symptom: The Study page failed because a required i18n import was missing.
root_cause: The i18n module wasn't imported into Study after localization was added.
fix: Added the i18n import and rebuilt.

title: White screen — app never mounts
symptom: Production showed a white screen (later a stuck splash) because the deployed JS never mounted #root.
root_cause: The Cloudflare Pages project had no build step (output = repo root), so it served raw source and index.html referenced asset hashes that didn't exist.
fix: Corrected the Pages build config (output dir `dist`) and deployed the real build so the entry module returns 200 application/javascript and the app mounts.

title: Cannot add posts, photos, stories, or profile photos
symptom: Post/photo/story/profile-photo uploads all failed.
root_cause: The media storage bucket was missing a scoped read policy (a privacy pass had dropped it), so authenticated reads of new media rows failed.
fix: Applied a migration restoring the `read media rows` policy plus client-side hardening in cloud.ts, fixing production instantly.

title: Profile can't add photos or posts
symptom: Users couldn't add new profile photos or posts.
root_cause: Writes reached Supabase as anon due to a stale/invalid client session, so correct RLS blocked avatar upload, post insert, and profile update.
fix: Hardened isAuthError/throwIfError to recognize storage auth failures so a bad session is refreshed-and-retried, then sent to re-sign-in.

title: Signed-in users saw 'Sign in' and no credits after reload
symptom: Returning users (page reload with an existing session) saw 'Sign in' and dashes instead of their name and credit balance.
root_cause: getProfile/ensureProfile/me()/myPlan/listInvoices used getUser() (a network call that returns null on a hiccup).
fix: Switched to getSession() (local + auto-refresh) and made the menu re-fetch on open.

title: Signup blocked by email confirmation
symptom: Signup was completely blocked, requiring email confirmation that often failed.
root_cause: Account creation depended on Supabase email-confirmation which was gated by a dashboard toggle.
fix: Added an edge function that creates confirmed accounts server-side and routed client signup through it, plus live handle-availability checks.

title: Signup email rate-limit trap
symptom: Signup failed with "Email rate limit exceeded" after a user corrected a mistyped email and retried.
root_cause: Supabase's built-in mailer cap (~2 confirmation emails/hour) was hit by the retry.
fix: Shipped fixes so the signup flow no longer trips the confirmation-email cap.

title: Social actions silently fail on a lapsed token
symptom: Stories, profile photo, adding posts and follow/unfollow appeared not to work with no error.
root_cause: Client errors were swallowed and follow/unfollow failed silently when the auth token had lapsed.
fix: Routed writes through `authedWrite` (refresh-and-retry) and surfaced errors, with an optimistic follow toggle and live count refresh.

title: Stale auth session causes RLS write failures
symptom: Posting failed with "new row violates row-level security policy" and profile-photo updates silently didn't work.
root_cause: A broken/expired client auth session sent writes to Supabase as anon, which correct RLS then blocked (avatar upload, post insert, profile update).
fix: Made me() proactively refresh the token, persist+auto-refresh the session, refresh-before-write, retry once, and re-prompt sign-in instead of showing a raw DB error.

title: Celebrations don't sync across devices
symptom: Celebrations added on one device didn't appear on the same account on another device.
root_cause: Countdowns/celebrations were localStorage-only (finished.countdowns) and never pushed to the cloud.
fix: Synced them to the user_data cloud table like notes/trackers.

title: Home tools grid needs a reload to show Calendar/Bookings/Task Manager
symptom: Users had to reload the whole app before Calendar, Bookings and Task Manager appeared in the tools grid.
root_cause: The home 'Tools' grid seeded once from localStorage, and cloud sync rewrote the tiles list but fired the wrong event, so the grid never refreshed.
fix: Re-read the tiles after a cloud sync (on the correct event) so tiles appear without a reload.

title: Sync pulls truncated at 1,000 rows
symptom: Cloud pulls were capped at 1,000 rows, dropping data beyond that.
root_cause: The pull query hit the default 1,000-row limit without pagination.
fix: Fixed the sync engine so pulls aren't truncated at 1,000 rows.

title: Camera stayed on after closing the recorder
symptom: The device camera remained active after the user exited the journal recorder.
root_cause: A classic async race left the media stream running on exit.
fix: Added a cancelled flag, nulled srcObject, and stopped the recorder on exit.

title: Loading splash kept randomly reappearing
symptom: After adding the splash, the loading splash kept popping up randomly.
root_cause: main.tsx re-registered the service worker on every load and the kill-switch SW called client.navigate() on activate, creating a re-register/re-activate/reload loop; also a timer-vs-network reload race.
fix: Stopped the SW reload loop so the boot script only recovers on genuine breakage (stale SW controls page → one reload).

title: PIN pad rapid-tap race
symptom: Fast typing on the PIN pad could drop a digit.
fix: Fixed the rapid-tap race so each keypress builds on the latest state and auto-submits on the 5th digit.

title: Rapid taps overwrite previous setting
symptom: Rapidly tapping a setting lost the previous value.
root_cause: A stale-closure overwrite meant each tap read an outdated state.
fix: Fixed it so each tap builds on the latest state.

title: Read-aloud voice was monotone then kept switching voices
symptom: Pressing play started with a robotic/monotone voice then switched to a different voice on each sentence.
root_cause: speak() fired before the browser voices finished loading (using the robotic default), and the fallback could land on a novelty voice.
fix: Waited for voices to load, resolved the chosen voice once, pinned it across all sentences, and blocklisted novelty voices.

title: Same-tick taps cancel each other
symptom: Two same-instant taps could cancel each other out.
root_cause: A race between two same-tick actions.
fix: Fixed the race so both same-tick actions now stick; verified in browser.

title: Sync race causing three sync defects
symptom: Three sync defects surfaced during testing.
root_cause: A genuine race condition in the sync path.
fix: Fixed the race at its cause, resolving all three sync defects.

title: 'See Plus' button was a dead-end
symptom: Clicking 'See Plus' did nothing.
fix: Wired 'See Plus' to open the plan-selection screen.

title: Assistant claims success for no-op actions on Pro
symptom: On Pro, asking the assistant to add a milestone, start a timer or invite a teammate created nothing yet it did not fail honestly (or returned the wrong hour).
root_cause: The assistant reported success for actions that never actually executed.
fix: Corrected the action wiring/reporting so it no longer claims success for nothing.

title: Celebration inline edits not saving
symptom: Editing celebrations directly on the main screen didn't work.
root_cause: Reproduced and root-caused in the browser (not theorized).
fix: Fixed the main-screen celebration edit path so edits apply.

title: Could sign up without choosing a plan/price
symptom: Signup completed without the user selecting a price.
fix: Required a plan pick during signup.

title: Countdown count-up broken
symptom: Birthday/anniversary countdowns didn't count down or up correctly.
fix: Fixed count-up and added days+hours, dd/mm/yyyy dates, and a repeats-every-year toggle.

title: Credit price mismatch between display and checkout
symptom: The app showed $19 for 100 credits while checkout charged $50, and two credit tiles 404'd.
root_cause: Pricing was not driven by a single source of truth across app, create-checkout, and Stripe.
fix: Introduced a canonical credits.ts tier table used everywhere so display matches checkout ($19 = 100 credits).

title: Day/Night toggle did not actually flip themes
symptom: Switching the Day/Night toggle did not reliably change modes.
root_cause: Midnight was secretly both a selectable colourway and the dark mode.
fix: Separated Midnight from dark mode so the Day/Night toggle now flips correctly.

title: Duplicate SlotEditor block in Scheduler edit
symptom: Scheduler edit rendered a duplicated slot editor.
root_cause: A stray duplicate {adding !== null && <SlotEditor>} block was present.
fix: Removed the stray duplicate block.

title: Empty Clipboard click did nothing
symptom: Clicking the Clipboard section when it was empty produced no response.
root_cause: The section only rendered if the user already had clipboard grabs, so an empty clipboard showed nothing.
fix: Made the Clipboard render and respond even when empty.

title: Google Translate silently returned untranslated text
symptom: Live Google Translate did not actually translate in the UI.
root_cause: The client hit the Cloudflare no-key echo first (silently short-circuiting), and the Supabase translate function read the key from the wrong secret location.
fix: Made the client call the Supabase function first and skip the no-key echo, and made Supabase translate read the key from the Vault.

title: Handle-availability indicator showed a stale result
symptom: The username handle checker showed a stale ✓ available against a name that was actually taken.
root_cause: The indicator kept the previous handle's result while the user typed the next character (client-side stale state); the RPC itself was fine.
fix: Fixed the stale state and added an authoritative re-check on submit.

title: Insert-table button could not add rows or columns
symptom: In docs, the insert-table feature didn't let users add rows and columns.
fix: Wired the table popover to add rows/columns.

title: Mic re-captures tab audio (echo)
symptom: Recordings had echo from the mic picking up the tab's own audio.
root_cause: The microphone re-captured the tab audio output.
fix: Applied the researched echo fix to the audio routing.

title: New accounts got the 'Close friends' circle added twice
symptom: A new account had two 'Close friends' circles seeded.
root_cause: Circle seeding was not idempotent.
fix: Made seeding idempotent (select + limit(1)) plus a DB unique index, and cleaned the existing duplicate.

title: NLP leaves attendee name in event title
symptom: 'Priya' stayed in the event title instead of becoming a guest chip.
root_cause: A bare weekday+time blocked the attendee match in the parser.
fix: Fixed the parser so the attendee is extracted into a guest chip.

title: Page doesn't translate on language change
symptom: Switching the language didn't translate the page.
root_cause: Client-side language-switch logic didn't translate page content.
fix: Implemented a whole-page auto-translator; verified English->French/Spanish with name and brand preserved.

title: PDF cover-title letter-spacing extraction
symptom: Letter-spaced PDF cover lines were mangled (e.g. "H A L L A L U / I N T E L L I G E N C E") and text was read out letter-by-letter instead of as whole words.
root_cause: pdfjs-dist glyph-position line assembly didn't account for the wide inter-letter gaps of letter-spaced text.
fix: Added per-line gap statistics (median x1.6), a collapse-regex safeguard, font-size heading detection with multi-line merge, and running-header removal.

title: Six milestone module bugs
symptom: Six reported milestone bugs affected the milestones feature.
root_cause: Multiple distinct root causes traced to source across the milestones code.
fix: Fixed all six milestone bugs at their root causes, each verified.

title: Split translation strings produced garbled copy
symptom: Translated sign-in copy came out garbled, e.g. 'Choisissez un 5Code PIN à 8 chiffres', and a card embedded the language name mid-sentence.
root_cause: Phrases were split into multiple pieces (and a language name embedded mid-sentence) so each fragment translated separately.
fix: Made each phrase a single string so it translates as one unit, and stopped embedding the language name mid-sentence.

title: Tracker empty-state showed 'under a minute' instead of '0 min'
symptom: With zero tracked time, the Tracker showed 'under a minute' (x3) rather than 0 min.
root_cause: The zero case fell through to the mins < 1 branch.
fix: Added if (totalMinutes === 0) return '0 min' before the 'under a minute' branch.

title: Transcription not in the user's language
symptom: Voice transcription didn't produce text in the user's selected language.
fix: Added a transcription-in-your-language fix alongside many more UI languages.

title: Translate batch cap regression dropped half of each batch
symptom: Legitimate localization batches would silently lose half their strings.
root_cause: The client sends up to 128 strings per request but the new server ceiling was set to 64.
fix: Raised the server per-request string ceiling to 128 in both the Supabase and Cloudflare versions.

title: UI strings (toasts, doc names) stayed in English when translating
symptom: After switching language, many words stayed in English including toast messages and document names.
root_cause: Hardcoded strings like showToast were not routed through the i18n/translation layer.
fix: Wired showToast and other strings through the translation system with new i18n keys so translation propagates app-wide.

title: Vault API key saved with trailing space
symptom: AI features would silently break after wiring up the key.
root_cause: The Vault secret was stored as "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY " with a trailing space in the key name.
fix: Corrected/normalized the secret name so the key is read correctly.

title: Word/character count differed between header and footer
symptom: The same doc showed 57 words in the header and 117 in the footer.
root_cause: The header (DocEditor) counted a stale plain-text content mirror while the footer (RichEditor) counted the live text.
fix: Pointed the header count at the live text so header and footer both show the correct count.

title: 52 RLS initplan performance warnings
symptom: RLS policies re-evaluated auth.uid() per row, flagged by 52 auth_rls_initplan advisories.
root_cause: Policies called auth.uid() directly instead of a subselect.
fix: Rewrote policies to use (select auth.uid()) per Supabase's recommendation.

title: Celebrations milliseconds re-render jank
symptom: Opening celebrations glitched when many cards ran with milliseconds.
root_cause: The whole list re-rendered every 60ms whenever any card displayed milliseconds.
fix: Drove all cards from one shared requestAnimationFrame clock with per-value gated re-renders.

title: Every-boot cache purge re-downloaded Whisper model
symptom: Each visit forced a ~40MB Whisper model re-download.
root_cause: The every-boot cache purge in main.tsx was deleting the Whisper model cache.
fix: Scoped the boot purge so it no longer wipes the model cache (commit 58f6245).

title: Redundant duplicate profile fetches
symptom: 250+ duplicate profile fetches were issued per session.
root_cause: Profile fetches weren't cached.
fix: Cached the profile fetch for 30 seconds.

title: Screen recording freezes in a background tab
symptom: Recordings froze whenever the tab was hidden or backgrounded.
root_cause: The draw loop was visibility-throttled when the tab wasn't focused.
fix: Drive the draw loop from a Web Worker timer with captureStream(0) + explicit requestFrame so capture isn't tied to compositing.

title: Screen recordings smeared and dropped frames from low bitrate and oversized canvas
symptom: 1080p+ screen text looked smeared in recordings, and frames were silently dropped on 4K/5K screens.
root_cause: The recorder used the browser default ~2.5 Mbps bitrate regardless of resolution and multiplied the compositor canvas by devicePixelRatio, so VP9 couldn't keep up in realtime above ~1080p.
fix: Raised the bitrate from 2.5 to 8 Mbps and capped the compositor canvas at ~1080p so the encoder keeps up and text stays sharp.

title: Tracker Edit did nothing then lagged ~1s before opening
symptom: Clicking Edit on a tracker appeared to do nothing, then the edit screen opened after a lag.
root_cause: Tracker groups recomputed on each render causing ~1s open latency.
fix: Memoised the tracker cards/groups via useMemo, cutting open time from ~1s to ~7ms.

title: '20 free' credits wording was incorrect
symptom: Copy said accounts start with 20 free when they actually start with 5.
root_cause: Stale '20 free' wording in five places.
fix: Changed '20 free' to '5 free' everywhere.

title: 'Add another tracker' button disappeared when trackers existed
symptom: The tracker builder hid the add button once trackers already existed.
fix: Builder now always shows 'Add another tracker' even with existing trackers.

title: 'Add homework' line too dark to see in dark mode
symptom: In homework, the add-homework line was too dark to read in dark mode.
fix: Lightened the add-homework line for dark-mode contrast.

title: 'Attach from library' opens an empty modal that does nothing
symptom: Attaching from the library opened an empty modal where nothing happened.
root_cause: The modal had no empty state and no upload path.
fix: Added empty states and an upload CTA and wired the artifact viewer.

title: 'Finished' wordmark rendered black in dark mode
symptom: The 'Finished' wordmark (and every 'X.' header) turned black and vanished in dark mode.
root_cause: The wordmark sat inside a <button>, which resets text color to black.
fix: Set .brand color to var(--ink) / rgb(238,243,255) so the wordmark stays light in dark mode.

title: Add-to-story modal stuck and oversized
symptom: Tapping "add to story" opened a modal that was stuck, too big, and falling off the page.
root_cause: The modal had no height cap and the story preview wasn't constrained.
fix: Capped the modal height with scroll and tightened the story preview.

title: App renders faded/flash on refresh
symptom: The app randomly showed up faded when refreshed or reopened.
root_cause: Loading-flash from the boot splash before the bundle loaded.
fix: Shipped a new static splash and a loading-flash fix.

title: Archived section header looked broken/cramped
symptom: The Archived section title rendered cramped/broken.
fix: Rebuilt it as a clean tappable pill '▾ Archived (n)' with one-tap Restore, and removed the 🗄 glyph.

title: Beautify blurred overlay unreadable
symptom: The Beautify screen used a translucent blurred overlay that was hard to read.
root_cause: It rendered as a blurred overlay rather than a solid page.
fix: Replaced it with a fixed opaque full-screen page.

title: Candy theme celebration tile text not readable
symptom: In the Candy theme, the celebrations tile numbers/text were hard to see against the gradient.
fix: Made the celebration numbers white with a dark shadow (also fixed matcha/babypink) for contrast.

title: Coloured-card titles low contrast
symptom: Titles on coloured cards rendered muted and hard to read.
fix: Fixed the titles to legible white for adequate contrast.

title: Confirm dialog used wrong verb for soft-cancel
symptom: The Confirm dialog's action button read 'Delete' for a soft-cancel action.
root_cause: Mislabeled action button verb.
fix: Corrected the button label to match the soft-cancel action.

title: Countdown numbers too small
symptom: Countdown/count-up numbers were tiny and wrapped onto multiple lines.
fix: Made the numbers big and one line, down to milliseconds.

title: Cover-flow peek clicks closed the modal
symptom: Clicking to peek in the cover-flow closed the whole modal.
root_cause: Peek click events bubbled up to the veil's close handler.
fix: Stopped the peek clicks from bubbling to the close handler.

title: CTA button end rendered dark like it was cut off
symptom: The end of the primary blue button looked dark/cut off, as if not fully rendered.
root_cause: The gradient stop rendered a dark edge.
fix: Set an explicit linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #4f93f8) on .onb-cta and .news-choice-btn.on so the button is fully blue.

title: Doc-editor header overcrowded and unclear
symptom: The doc editor's top bar was a confusing strip where it wasn't clear what was on top vs bottom.
root_cause: `.we-bar` was a single flex row cramming the title, word/char stats and ~10 tool controls.
fix: Made `.we-bar` flex-wrap and protected the title so the toolbar wraps cleanly.

title: Emoji picker didn't close on outside click
symptom: Clicking outside the emoji picker left it open.
fix: Made the picker close when clicking anywhere outside it.

title: Emoji picker horizontal overflow
symptom: The emoji picker slid sideways and emojis didn't fit inside the box.
root_cause: Unconstrained picker width allowed horizontal drift.
fix: Constrained the picker to 340px / 8 columns with vertical-only scroll, verified inside the viewport.

title: File menu dropdown rendered behind the toolbar
symptom: Opening the File menu showed a glitch where the dropdown painted behind the editor toolbar.
root_cause: The static .we-bar header created a stacking context, so the dropdown sat behind the later toolbar.
fix: Elevated the header's stacking order so the File dropdown paints above the toolbar.

title: Freeze-count copy missing a separator
symptom: The tracker copy read '3 freezes left this month keep it safe' with no separator.
fix: Changed copy to '{freezesLeft()} freeze(s) left this month · they keep your streak safe'.

title: Frozen blank screen while generating in 'Write it for me' modal
symptom: The Write-it modal appeared frozen with no feedback while content was being generated.
root_cause: No loading/thinking indicator was shown during generation.
fix: Added an animated 'thinking' indicator so the screen no longer appears frozen.

title: Header logo circle-inside-a-circle
symptom: The header logo rendered as a nested circle-inside-a-circle instead of the intended mark.
root_cause: A second circle was nested inside the logo circle.
fix: Rebuilt it as a single light-blue circle with a blue tick next to "Finished."

title: Home loads scrolled down with logo above the fold
symptom: The home page loaded already scrolled down.
root_cause: The home scrolls inside a height:100% container, so window.scrollTo(0,0) didn't reset it.
fix: Added a proper scroll reset in App.tsx, with the fixed boot splash masking the reset.

title: Imprecise crop preview
symptom: The crop preview implied the image wouldn't fit, yet the full image appeared once posted.
root_cause: The crop preview didn't accurately reflect the final framing.
fix: Fixed the preview to match output and added zoom in/out for timeline and profile photos.

title: Invalid hex color in boot splash CSS
symptom: The boot splash background color was malformed.
root_cause: A stray space made the hex invalid (#eaf0 fe).
fix: Corrected the hex to #eaf0fe.

title: Launch-checklist checkmark rendered as a tiny square tick
symptom: The launch checklist checkmark was a tiny tick in a square, not a big white tick in a circle like the logo.
fix: Replaced it with a clean big white check-circle (V1 and V2).

title: Library star ratings render as huge dashed 'cylinder' boxes
symptom: Book star ratings appeared as tall dashed boxes overlapping cards.
root_cause: The empty-star span className 'empty' collided with the app's global .empty empty-state box (an 84x170px dashed placeholder).
fix: Renamed/scoped the star glyph classes (.bt-empty at 18x18px) and added gradient book-cover thumbnails.

title: Light-hardcoded surfaces stranded dark text in dark mode
symptom: The 'JUMP BACK IN' card and other surfaces stayed light in dark mode, leaving text unreadable.
root_cause: Those surfaces had hardcoded light colors that ignored dark mode.
fix: Made the JUMP BACK IN card and other surfaces dark with light text in dark mode.

title: Loading splash flickers in a self-heal reload loop
symptom: The loading animation kept randomly reappearing.
root_cause: With #root empty, the 10s self-heal timer fired location.reload(), re-showing the splash in a repeating loop.
fix: Fixing the mount stopped the loop, and the boot script was simplified to one-shot recovery to remove the timer-vs-network flicker.

title: Logo dot not aligned inline with wordmark
symptom: The brand logo dot sat out of line with the wordmark.
fix: Aligned the dot inline so dotTop equals brandTop.

title: Memoriser cut off on mobile
symptom: The memoriser was cut off on mobile in Study.
fix: Fixed the mobile layout so the memoriser isn't clipped.

title: Memoriser white-box text invisible in dark mode
symptom: In the Memoriser, text in the white box was barely visible in dark mode.
fix: Revamped Memoriser dark-mode contrast so the box text is readable.

title: Milestones card layout shifts with content
symptom: Milestones cards had buttons and progress bars in different positions depending on whether a card had a note.
root_cause: Cards weren't equal height, so controls floated based on content.
fix: Made cards equal height so progress bars and "It happened!" buttons sit in the same position.

title: Mobile CSS rule leaking to desktop
symptom: Layout overlap appeared on non-mobile viewports.
root_cause: A mobile width:100%!important rule was declared outside its media query.
fix: Scoped the mobile rule back inside its media query, resolving the overlap.

title: Mobile sticky CTA overlap on booking page
symptom: The mobile sticky CTA overlapped the Style/Edit buttons.
fix: Stacked the Style/Edit buttons above the sticky CTA to remove the overlap.

title: Orphan word 'bed' wrapped alone in onboarding tour card
symptom: The onboarding tour body text left the word 'bed' stranded on its own line.
fix: Applied text-wrap so the phrase wraps together (…on a walk or in bed.).

title: Oversized /help and doc toolbar buttons
symptom: The AI-artifact buttons were bulky full-width pills and the '/help' button was oversized and wrapped.
root_cause: The buttons inherited global styles instead of being scoped to the toolbar.
fix: Scoped dedicated classes (pj-doc-btn, flex-grow:0, content-sized) so buttons are tidy and match the toolbar scale.

title: Planner copy says morning for afternoon slots
symptom: The planner said 'protected in the morning' even for afternoon slots.
root_cause: Static copy not conditioned on slot time.
fix: Made the copy match the slot's time of day.

title: Privacy/Terms links returned 404
symptom: The Privacy and Terms redirects did not work.
fix: Fixed routing so the Privacy page renders at /?legal=privacy (404 resolved).

title: Progress ring percentage unreadable in dark/Midnight theme
symptom: The number inside the progress wheel and some text was hard to see at midnight/dark mode.
root_cause: ProgressRing color was not theme-aware and tint dimming applied in dark mode.
fix: Made ProgressRing theme-aware (white/readable % on every theme) and overrode the dark-mode tint dimming.

title: Rainbow splash animation keeps regressing
symptom: The moving rainbow colour-splash first-load animation had reverted to static.
root_cause: A git regression reintroduced the static splash.
fix: Restored the animated splash and pinned/guarded it against regressing again.

title: Re-picking the same story photo doesn't fire
symptom: Selecting the same photo again for a story did nothing.
root_cause: The file input wasn't reset, so re-selecting the same file didn't emit a change event.
fix: Reset the story file input after selection (Stories.tsx).

title: Screen Studio scenes stretched in resized window
symptom: A half-sized window stretched scenes blurry/stocky instead of scaling cleanly.
root_cause: Scenes were not constrained to a fixed contain-fit stage.
fix: Made scenes a fixed 16:9 contain-fit stage so a resized window letterboxes.

title: Sign-in / sign-up screens cut off at the top
symptom: The auth screens were clipped at the top on short viewports.
root_cause: AuthGate used flexbox + overflow that clipped the top on short viewports.
fix: Switched AuthGate to a robust block layout so the top is no longer cropped.

title: Sign-in splash rendered broken
symptom: The sign-in splash would have rendered broken.
root_cause: CSS class-name collisions corrupted the splash styling.
fix: Used unique class names and restored the original design (glowing ring, breathing logo, gradient bar).

title: Story black-flash before photo
symptom: Opening a story showed a black screen before the photo loaded.
fix: Fixed the black-flash (verified by code, since a real story couldn't be driven locally).

title: Time page horizontal scroll
symptom: The Time page scrolled sideways.
root_cause: Element width exceeded the card/viewport.
fix: Applied a width fix so content fits within the card.

title: Timezone label shows underscores
symptom: A timezone displayed as 'Port_of_Spain'.
root_cause: The raw IANA identifier wasn't humanized.
fix: Displayed 'Port of Spain' (underscores stripped).

title: Timezone picker truncates country names
symptom: The timezone picker button truncated long country names.
root_cause: The picker button layout ellipsized the country name.
fix: Restructured the button to show the full country name on its own line.

title: Two bugs in the photo crop dialog
symptom: The photo crop dialog misbehaved.
root_cause: Two defects in CropModal.tsx (loop / blob-URL handling).
fix: Fixed both CropModal.tsx bugs and committed.

title: Typo in classic theme CSS
symptom: A typo had slipped into the classic theme's CSS.
root_cause: Malformed CSS in the classic theme.
fix: Corrected the typo.

title: Ugly native prompt() used in Work feature
symptom: The Work feature used a raw browser prompt() dialog.
fix: Replaced the prompt() with proper in-app UI (and added focus-stop celebration).

title: All AI silently ran on Gemini fallback instead of Claude
symptom: AI features silently used the degraded Gemini fallback rather than Claude.
root_cause: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was stored in the Vault with a trailing space (unreadable), and edge functions read secrets from Deno.env rather than the Vault.
fix: Created a read_vault_secret RPC that trims names (trim(name)=trim(secret_name)) so the key resolves and functions read the Vault.

title: Downloaded webm has infinite/no duration
symptom: Downloaded recordings had no duration header and wouldn't seek.
root_cause: Chrome writes no duration metadata for timesliced recordings.
fix: Patch wall-clock, pause-aware duration into the file with fix-webm-duration so downloads seek.

title: fix-webm-duration dependency dropped from package.json
symptom: The Cloudflare deploy would have broken even though local builds passed.
root_cause: A concurrent session's commit had wiped `fix-webm-duration` out of package.json.
fix: Restored the dependency in package.json.

title: Password-reset emails sent from an unverified domain
symptom: The send-reset function would have its emails rejected by Resend.
root_cause: The function sent from hi@hallalu.com, which is not the verified domain.
fix: Changed the from address to hi@finished.hallalu.com (verified) with reply-to hi@hallalu.com.

title: Shared-Supabase table collision broke the Stripe-entitlements migration
symptom: Wiring Stripe entitlements failed with 'column email doesn't exist on existing profiles'.
root_cause: Finished. shared its Supabase project with other apps, colliding with a pre-existing profiles table that lacked the expected column.
fix: Namespaced Finished.'s tables as finished_* so they no longer collide with the shared schema.

title: Stale cached JavaScript made features appear broken
symptom: Write templates, the Homework + button, and AI features all did nothing even though the code was correct.
root_cause: The deployed app was serving stale JavaScript from the service worker cache.
fix: Fixed the service worker so every deploy arrives instantly (with a one-time hard-refresh to clear the old bundle).

title: Business-plan /pitch gate bypassable via path tricks
symptom: The gated /pitch content could be reached with two path tricks despite the gate.
root_cause: The gate only guarded the route while the protected content still shipped in the static asset bundle.
fix: Removed the protected content from the asset bundle entirely so the gate actually holds.

title: Owner email exposed client-side in admin.js
symptom: The admin owner email was shipped in the client-side admin.js bundle.
root_cause: The owner-email/admin check lived in client code instead of on the server.
fix: Moved the owner email/admin check server-side.

title: Invoice builder wipes line items on every repaint
symptom: 'Add a line' did nothing and invoices could not be saved.
root_cause: invoiceBuilder() re-initialised the line items on every repaint, wiping typed input.
fix: Separated initialization from repaint so line items persist, and corrected the maths.

title: /api/track throws TDZ from duplicate
symptom: The `/api/track` endpoint threw a temporal-dead-zone error.
root_cause: A leftover duplicate declaration.
fix: Removed the duplicate; endpoint works.

title: Admin check crashes for signed-out users
symptom: The app would crash for signed-out visitors.
root_cause: `isAdminUser()` dereferenced a null account.
fix: Added a null guard.

title: Hallucinated Stripe checkout APIs
symptom: Checkout would have failed the instant real keys were added.
root_cause: A previous session used non-existent Stripe APIs (a fake 'Dahlia' Stripe.js, `createEmbeddedCheckoutPage`, and a fabricated `API_VERSION='2026-07-29.dahlia'`).
fix: Rewrote to the real Embedded Checkout API and correct version header (four fixes).

title: Stale HTML shell served from cache
symptom: The browser kept serving a stale index.html, making fixes look broken for testers and real users.
root_cause: The HTML shell was being cached even though versioned assets already handle caching.
fix: Made the shell never cache so deploys are picked up immediately.

title: Billing view shows outdated Solo/Studio/£19 pricing
symptom: The billing/pricing view still displayed the old Solo/Studio tiers with a £19 price even for the free plan (the 'free 19 pounds' bug).
root_cause: The billing view rendered a stale pricing model instead of the current flat tiers.
fix: Rewrote the billing view to USD flat pricing with free=$0 and stripped the pricing promises.

title: Call recap invents bullets and ignores the transcript
symptom: The grounded-outreach call recap showed hardcoded bullets (e.g. 'Friday'/'mockup') instead of anything from the actual call.
root_cause: extractPoints invented 4 hardcoded bullets when the transcript was short and showRecap never sent the transcript to the AI, rendering static templates.
fix: Grounded the recap in the real transcript with a non-inventing fallback so the key points come from the user's own words.

title: Currency search fails on plurals and place names
symptom: Typing terms like 'dollars', 'trinidad' or 'america' into the currency search returned no match.
root_cause: curSearch didn't stem trailing plurals (or map related place terms), so 'dollars' never matched 'dollar'.
fix: Made curSearch stem trailing plurals so plural and related terms resolve to the right currency.

title: Date handling produced the wrong year
symptom: Goal/close dates resolved to the wrong year (e.g. 2024, and 'next Tuesday' became 2027).
root_cause: Date arithmetic was wrong and the first guard only blocked past dates, pushing them to 2027.
fix: Fixed date computation generally so relative dates resolve to the correct year.

title: Dead route after creating a project while viewing a client
symptom: Creating a project while viewing a client left the user on a dead route.
root_cause: Navigation state after project creation resolved to an invalid route.
fix: Corrected the post-creation navigation so it lands on a valid view.

title: Delete actions silently do nothing
symptom: Several delete controls appeared to work but deleted nothing.
root_cause: The delete handlers were not wired to actually remove the item.
fix: Fixed the deletes and added delete-confirmations everywhere.

title: Demo comms/leads didn't seed
symptom: The demo's communications/leads didn't appear because they were never seeded.
root_cause: Leads live in per-project data, but the demo seeded to st.leads (the wrong data path).
fix: Fixed the demo seed path so demo leads/comms populate.

title: Demo shows wrong base currency
symptom: The UK demo displayed USD instead of GBP.
root_cause: A stale demo from before currency settings existed left USD hard-coded.
fix: Set `st.settings.baseCurrency='GBP'` in decorateDemo.

title: Editing a lead can't set Google/Maps source
symptom: Google/Maps couldn't be chosen when editing a lead, and demo leads were mislabeled call/email.
root_cause: The edit form offered only 4 sources instead of the full source picker.
fix: Switched the edit form to the full source picker and corrected the demo leads.

title: Hardcoded '3.1×' caption
symptom: A '3.1×' caption was displayed as if computed but was hardcoded.
root_cause: The multiplier was a static string rather than derived from data.
fix: Corrected the caption for honesty rather than hardcoding it.

title: Landing page silently redirects onboarded users to /app
symptom: The deployed landing page at / was never visible to onboarded users because it silently bounced them to /app.
root_cause: An onboarded-user redirect fired unconditionally at the root route.
fix: Fixed the redirect (adding an ?app override) so the landing page is reachable.

title: Local 'pct' variable shadows global pct() function
symptom: A percentage calculation misbehaved due to name collision.
root_cause: A local variable named pct shadowed the global pct() function.
fix: Renamed the shadowing local variable to remove the collision.

title: NaN% reply rate and non-zero outreach on empty project
symptom: An empty project showed NaN% for reply rate and a fresh project did not start its outreach count at 0.
root_cause: Metrics divided by zero / lacked initialization for empty projects.
fix: Removed the NaN and made a fresh project start outreach count at 0.

title: Paste importer mis-parses co.uk domains
symptom: Pasted leads with `.co.uk` sites and business domains were parsed wrong (domain treated as email).
root_cause: TLD ordering matched `co` before `co.uk`, and business-domain-vs-email wasn't distinguished.
fix: Fixed TLD ordering so `co.uk` matches first and separated business domain from email.

title: Paste importer treats a whole Google Maps paste as one lead
symptom: Pasting Google Maps results imported only 'found 1 lead' and used the first line 'Sponsored' as the lead's name.
root_cause: The importer split leads on blank lines, but Google Maps pastes have none, so the entire block parsed as a single lead.
fix: Reworked the importer so a run-together paste splits into individual leads (via the AI-split path) instead of one block.

title: Phone-number parser misreads across lines
symptom: Phone parsing failed on multi-line input and numbers with a leading parenthesis.
root_cause: The phone regex crossed line boundaries and didn't allow a leading paren.
fix: Rewrote the phone pattern to stay on one line and allow a leading paren.

title: Read-aloud reply and button do nothing
symptom: The assistant's reply did not speak and the read-aloud button after the fact did nothing.
root_cause: The speak-on-reply path and the manual read-aloud handler were both broken.
fix: Fixed both halves so replies speak and the button works.

title: Rolodex cards show fields with no way to enter them
symptom: Contact cards displayed fields (e.g. in influencers) that had no corresponding input path.
root_cause: Card display and the entry form were driven by different definitions.
fix: Refactored so one schema drives both the card and the entry form.

title: Sign-out always prompts a confirm, breaking auto-forget
symptom: signOut always showed a confirmation dialog, which is wrong for the auto-forget (ephemeral 'keep me signed in') flow.
root_cause: The sign-out path unconditionally showed a confirm dialog regardless of the ephemeral/auto-forget session mode.
fix: Made the ephemeral auto-forget sign-out skip the confirm dialog.

title: Trial→paid KPI shows NaN%
symptom: The admin dashboard's 'Trial→paid' KPI rendered NaN%.
root_cause: An operator-precedence error in the KPI calculation.
fix: Corrected the precedence so the KPI computes a real percentage.

title: Worker chunking not byte-safe and header auth broken
symptom: Worker request chunking and header-based auth were faulty.
root_cause: Chunking split on characters rather than bytes and auth headers were mishandled.
fix: Reworked the worker for byte-safe chunking and correct header auth.

title: Add-expense modal locked to 7 hardcoded categories
symptom: The add-expense modal offered only a hardcoded list of 7 categories with no way to enter a custom one.
root_cause: The add-expense modal hardcoded a 7-item category list with no custom-entry option.
fix: Expanded the category list and added a type-your-own custom option.

title: AI status stuck on 'Checking…' when API unreachable
symptom: The AI buttons showed a perpetual 'Checking…' state and failed silently when the API was not reachable locally.
root_cause: The unreachable-API case was not handled with a clear state.
fix: Made the buttons report exactly what is missing instead of hanging or failing silently.

title: Ava assistant invisible on mobile/dark
symptom: The Ava assistant was white-on-white and unreadable in dark mode on phones.
root_cause: Hard-coded #fff surfaces gave zero contrast on the hero stage, reply bubbles, and chips.
fix: Fixed three contrast bugs and added a real mobile layout for the Ava page.

title: Broken Followers/Following/Photo grid
symptom: The Followers/Following and Photo layout was mis-arranged.
root_cause: The grid pairing was wrong.
fix: Made Followers/Following a proper pair with Photo on its own row.

title: Clients-signed ring misaligned
symptom: Ring numerals sat on different baselines and the 'clients signed' label was small and off-center.
root_cause: Numerator/denominator and label were not aligned or sized correctly.
fix: Aligned numerals on one baseline with a smaller denominator and centered/enlarged the label.

title: Confetti persists under tab throttling
symptom: Confetti outlived its welcome, lingering after it should have cleared.
root_cause: The confetti animation was not cleaned up when the browser throttled the background tab.
fix: Cleared the confetti so it no longer outlives its animation.

title: Contact card not full width
symptom: The rich-contact card rendered narrower than the container.
root_cause: A helper constrained the card width.
fix: Fixed the helper; card is now full width (689px).

title: Dark-mode hero/aurora + a dozen surfaces stay light (invisible text)
symptom: In dark mode the hero/aurora card and many other surfaces stayed white, making their text invisible.
root_cause: .hero had a hardcoded background:#fff and only .card/.modal/.sheet had dark overrides — .hero/.profile-hero/.pstats/.call-stage/.rolo-card/.cmdk/.drawer/.onb had none.
fix: Added dark-mode overrides for all the uncovered surfaces so every card is readable in dark mode.

title: Demo portraits mismatch names and gender
symptom: Demo lead photos didn't match the leads' names or gender.
root_cause: Photos used random `i.pravatar.cc/?u=` URLs.
fix: Replaced with gender-inferred `randomuser.me` portraits via name-set heuristics.

title: Header buttons overflow, blocking Add to-do
symptom: On a phone the 'Add to-do' button was clipped off the right edge, so users couldn't add a goal/to-do.
root_cause: `.topbar` had no `flex-wrap`, so the action buttons overflowed on narrow screens.
fix: Added flex-wrap to `.topbar`, fixing every view that uses the pattern.

title: Microphone icon not centered in inputs
symptom: The mic sat near the top line instead of centered in goal, to-do and other fields.
root_cause: The mic was centered on the combined label+field height instead of just the field.
fix: Re-centered every mic in the app so each measures 0px off-center.

title: Mobile FAB overlaps the 5-tab bottom bar
symptom: On mobile the floating action button sat over the taller 5-tab bottom bar and the tab labels wrapped.
root_cause: The FAB wasn't raised above the taller 5-tab bar and the tab labels were too long to fit on one line.
fix: Raised the FAB to a 23px gap above the bar, made it slightly smaller, and switched to short single-word tab labels.

title: Start screen mic oversized and off-centre
symptom: The onboarding Start screen's record mic rendered too large and not centred.
root_cause: The Start screen mic was unsized/mispositioned instead of a single centred control.
fix: Rebuilt it as a single, smaller, centred mic.

title: Tax page not findable in the nav
symptom: The Tax page existed but users couldn't find or reach it.
root_cause: Tax wasn't surfaced as a real, navigable page in the nav.
fix: Made Tax a real, findable page in the nav (and expanded the spend categories).

title: Timezone widget falls off screen
symptom: Swapping timezones pushed the widget off-screen at mid widths.
root_cause: The timezone inputs didn't shrink or stack on narrow layouts.
fix: Made the inputs shrinkable and stack earlier; verified no overflow at any width.

title: Unsized SVG renders oversized
symptom: An SVG rendered giant on screen.
root_cause: The SVG had no explicit dimensions.
fix: Sized the SVG so it renders correctly.

title: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY saved with a leading space
symptom: AI features silently did not work.
root_cause: The secret was stored as ' ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' with a leading space, so env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was undefined.
fix: Added a whitespace-tolerant secret() resolver so the key resolves regardless of stray whitespace.

title: Cloudflare env-var blocker (no worker script)
symptom: Cloudflare rejected env vars with 'Variables cannot be added to a Worker that only has static assets'.
root_cause: The Hallalu deployment had only static files and no worker script, so secrets could not attach.
fix: Added a worker script so environment variables can be bound.

title: extras.js not loading
symptom: The extras.js script failed to load.
fix: Corrected the loading so extras.js is included.

title: Legally wrong review-gating claims in shipped copy
symptom: The app told users incorrect legal facts about review gating (e.g. 'illegal in the UK', 'FTC rule covers gating', a mischaracterised Yelp rule).
root_cause: Four shipped legal claims and review-solicitation copy were inaccurate.
fix: Corrected all four claims and replaced the generic 'reviews' source with three platform-specific rule sets.

title: Co-stitch rooms and theme leak across accounts
symptom: The next person on the device auto-joined your live co-stitch room and kept your theme.
root_cause: Co-stitch room membership and appearance were not scoped per account.
fix: Scoped co-stitch rooms and appearance per account so they no longer leak between users.

title: Security headers silently ignored
symptom: Security/CSP headers added in the worker did nothing.
root_cause: Cloudflare serves static assets before the worker runs, so worker-set headers never applied.
fix: Moved the headers to the proper `_headers` mechanism.

title: Stored-XSS vectors in user content
symptom: Multiple stored-XSS injection points, including an unescaped server value reaching an HTML attribute.
root_cause: User/server values were rendered without escaping.
fix: Escaped the values and closed all five stored-XSS vectors.

title: 'Reset everything' resurrects data on reload
symptom: Resetting everything did not stick; data came back on the next reload.
root_cause: Reset left the rolling backup behind, and the loss-protection loader (which prefers whichever copy has more projects) resurrected everything.
fix: Made reset also clear the rolling backup so it no longer resurrects.

title: Cross-account data leak on shared device
symptom: A second person signing up on the same device saw the first user's projects and streak.
root_cause: Accounts were stored in a single storage slot with no per-account scoping.
fix: Scoped storage per account so a new user starts empty (proven: Bea sees zero projects).

title: Duplicate chart projects on every reload
symptom: Reloading created a brand-new duplicate of the same chart project (three identically-named ones appeared).
root_cause: `savedId` was never persisted, so each reload treated the chart as new.
fix: Persisted savedId so a chart maps to one project.

title: Projects view wiped by a single corrupt save
symptom: The projects view went blank with no warning.
root_cause: `load()` silently fell back to empty defaults on any parse error, so one corrupt/truncated save destroyed everything.
fix: Added backups and recovery (preserve the broken copy) and made each card render independently so one bad project can't blank the list.

title: Resize wipes the canvas artwork
symptom: Resizing the grid erased the user's drawing.
root_cause: The resize path cleared the canvas instead of preserving it.
fix: Resize now preserves existing artwork.

title: Sign-up orphans or clobbers pre-account data
symptom: Signing up could vanish pre-account projects or clobber an existing local store for a handle.
root_cause: Pre-account projects were stored behind an ownerless key and sign-up did not adopt or protect them.
fix: Pre-account projects are adopted by the first signer, and sign-up refuses a handle with an existing store and points to sign-in.

title: Boot crash from temporal dead zone
symptom: The entire app died on first load with no console error.
root_cause: `termKey` read `db` while `let db = load()` was still initializing (TDZ).
fix: Reordered initialization so `db` exists before it is referenced.

title: HUD crash on second render
symptom: Every count after the first would crash.
root_cause: `renderCover` referenced an element its own rebuild had already destroyed.
fix: Reworked renderCover to not reference the destroyed element.

title: LS_BAK temporal dead zone crash
symptom: The app refused to boot.
root_cause: `LS_BAK` was declared after `db=load()` ran, a use-before-initialisation TDZ.
fix: Moved the declaration before it is used.

title: Passcode lockout with no escape hatch
symptom: User was asked for a passcode they never set and could not get in.
root_cause: A browser test left a lock flag in storage and there was no recovery path.
fix: Added a forgot-passcode escape hatch (fixed three ways) and cleared the stray flag.

title: Cell-click runs past end of row
symptom: Clicking a cell could advance past the last stitch of a row into the next one.
root_cause: No bound check on the click-to-advance path.
fix: Clamped cell clicks to the current row's end.

title: Chart collapses to a tiny thumbnail
symptom: The chart shrank to a thumbnail inside a huge empty page card.
root_cause: A scale calculation ran while the container was hidden (width read 0, scale went negative).
fix: Removed transform-scaling and made the grid fill the page width with real cells.

title: Chart-grow message flow miscounts
symptom: The chart stage didn't repaint per message, the prompt offered to add skips instead of stitches, and it grew the wrong row.
root_cause: Stage wasn't refreshed per message and the grow logic targeted a stale row index / wrong element type.
fix: Repaint per message, name real stitches, and grow the correct row (verified 30→32).

title: Community tab is a dead end
symptom: Community refused with a toast telling the user to sign in via Settings.
root_cause: It gated on a sign-in path that led nowhere.
fix: Fixed the Community entry so it no longer dead-ends.

title: Competing writers miscount home tiles
symptom: The home tile still counted 13 stitches from a stale value.
root_cause: Two ppMeta writers fought over the home tile count and the stale one won.
fix: Consolidated to a single ppMeta writer.

title: Dictation mic leak into counting view
symptom: After dictating rows then hitting Save & start counting, speech kept appending rows to a stale draft instead of counting.
root_cause: The mic stayed live with the dictation handler still attached when entering the counting studio.
fix: Mic now hard-stops on entering the counting studio.

title: Learn-to-read-charts modal silently fails
symptom: Opening 'Learn to read charts' did nothing visible.
root_cause: It opened a modal that silently failed.
fix: Fixed the modal so the guide opens correctly.

title: Notation parser undercounts stitches ('7 vs 18')
symptom: Stitch totals came out far too low, e.g. reporting 7 when it should be 18.
root_cause: Two parser bugs — e.g. '6 sc in magic ring' collapsed to a single count, and many notation variants weren't recognized.
fix: Parser overhaul plus a `normalizeNotation` that folds standing/stacked/foundation/post/Ntog/magic-ring variants into keys.

title: Billing panel invisible at 0x0
symptom: The billing panel had content but measured 0x0 and never showed.
root_cause: A sizing rule collapsed the panel (and ten similar panels) to zero dimensions.
fix: One layout rule fixed all eleven; billing now renders at 560x740.

title: Dead hero photo on landing page
symptom: The landing hero image 404'd, showing a broken tile.
root_cause: It pointed at an expired Unsplash premium URL.
fix: Swapped to a verified-200 photo and added a fallback that hides any tile whose image fails.

title: Duplicate DOM ids after bento redesign
symptom: Nine duplicate DOM ids made home-tile buttons behave unpredictably.
root_cause: Replacing the home markup left the old tile row in place below the new bento.
fix: Removed the leftover old tile row.

title: iOS text too close to phone edge
symptom: In the iOS simulator, words sat too close to the edge of the phone.
root_cause: Horizontal padding was below Apple's 16pt margin guidance.
fix: Raised horizontal padding to 22pt with the title at 27pt.

title: Menu hidden behind next card
symptom: The project menu rendered behind the following card instead of on top.
root_cause: Z-index stacking-context bug.
fix: Fixed the stacking so the menu layers above adjacent cards.

title: Mic control runs off screen on real devices
symptom: The mic control ran off the edge of the screen on real devices.
root_cause: A missing/incorrect viewport meta tag.
fix: Corrected the viewport meta tag.

title: Mislabeled +n count bubble
symptom: The +n increment bubble showed the wrong number.
fix: Corrected the bubble's label calculation.

title: Settings button opened nothing
symptom: The Settings control was genuinely broken and didn't open the panel.
root_cause: `#settingsSheet` was the backdrop element, not the panel itself.
fix: Corrected the settings sheet structure so the panel opens.

title: Stale CSS rule squishes knit cells
symptom: Knit grid cells rendered square despite correct code.
root_cause: A leftover `.gm-cell` CSS rule from the old grid maker silently overrode the new knit geometry.
fix: Removed the stale rule so per-craft geometry applies.

title: Tile colour clashes with theme accent
symptom: Tile colours (e.g. purple) did not match the theme the user picked.
root_cause: Tile background wasn't bound to the chosen accent colour.
fix: Tiles now follow the theme's colour and each tile background is picker-controlled.

title: CSP blocks YouTube thumbnails and embeds
symptom: The new CSP would have broken YouTube thumbnails and video embeds.
root_cause: The content-security-policy was too strict for the embed resources.
fix: Widened the CSP and re-verified zero blocked resources.

title: Users served stale app version
symptom: Returning users silently ran old JavaScript/HTML, making just-added features look missing.
root_cause: The `?v=` cache-busters weren't regenerated and HTML wasn't revalidated at the cache layer.
fix: Bumped/regenerated the `?v=` stamps and made HTML always revalidate.

title: Proprietary pricing/cost information leaking in the app
symptom: The app displayed confidential proprietary information such as per-credit cost and margins.
root_cause: Internal-economics copy and figures were exposed in the shipped bundle.
fix: Audited and fixed all five leaks (e.g. margin language replaced) and verified a clean leak-scan.

title: Preview freezes at an outdated state
symptom: The visual preview froze at an outdated state (preview sync bug).
root_cause: Generators ran client-side without a guard against stale async responses.
fix: Moved generators to the worker with a cached, stale-response-guarded async shim and a 350ms hue-slider debounce.

title: Stale-closure loses rapid goal/checklist clicks
symptom: Rapid goal clicks used stale state (Income got overwritten by Community) and rapid checklist clicks registered only 1 of 3.
root_cause: Handlers captured stale state in a closure instead of using the latest value.
fix: Switched to a functional updater/toggle so each rapid click registers.

title: Dead landing CTA buttons
symptom: Landing page CTA buttons did nothing (user-blocking).
root_cause: The 'Start building' nav pill was a plain #start anchor with no action wired.
fix: Made the nav pill a real action, made the empty-input nudge unmissable, and un-crowded mobile nav.

title: Generated files stamped with year 1996
symptom: Generated files were timestamped 1996 instead of 2026.
root_cause: A wrong timestamp base in the file generator.
fix: Corrected the timestamp so files stamp the current year.

title: Greeting rotation regression
symptom: The per-visit greeting rotation regressed during a change.
root_cause: A regression introduced while editing the greeting logic.
fix: Caught and fixed the regression so greetings rotate per visit from the pool.

title: Kotlin extension properties fail through fully-qualified chains
symptom: Every exported Kotlin app would fail to compile on certain property access.
root_cause: The generator template emitted Kotlin extension properties resolved through fully-qualified chains, which Kotlin cannot resolve.
fix: Fixed the generator template (and live generator) so extension properties resolve correctly.

title: Android FAB not to Material 3 spec
symptom: The Android floating action button had the wrong spec and clearance.
root_cause: FAB sizing/clearance did not follow M3.
fix: Rebuilt the Android FAB to M3 spec with correct clearance.

title: Barber app shows a wrong photo
symptom: The barber demo app rendered a wrong/mismatched photo.
root_cause: An ambiguous/mismatched image was used at hero crop.
fix: Rendered mesh-art plus gradient-initial 'MR' avatars instead of the wrong photo.

title: Composer bar shows giant gradient pills
symptom: The dashboard composer bar rendered giant gradient pills instead of a compact input/mic/button.
root_cause: It inherited the landing hero styles (a CSS inheritance bug).
fix: Scoped the composer styles to input-first, 40px mic at its side, compact 96px 'New app'.

title: Desktop/Mac/Web preview renders as a banner and single column
symptom: Desktop, Mac and Web previews showed a lone phone column / banner and one name instead of a full-screen multi-column layout.
root_cause: One CSS keyword prevented auto-fit multi-column from firing, and a 118px card floor collapsed grids to one column.
fix: Made columns follow measured pane width via auto-fit and lowered the card floor to 70px for genuine multi-column desktop layouts.

title: Empty-prompt CTA silently does nothing
symptom: Clicking 'New app' or 'Start building' with an empty prompt box did nothing — no builder, error, or feedback.
root_cause: The `if (!text) return` guard in `start()` bailed silently.
fix: Empty click now focuses the input, shakes the prompt bar, and highlights the hint.

title: Mobile nav wrap and file-list truncation
symptom: In the narrow panel view the mobile nav wrapped and the file list truncated.
root_cause: Layout did not handle the narrow width.
fix: Fixed the mobile nav wrap and file-list truncation.

title: Pitch deck low contrast and overlapping footnotes
symptom: Grey text on slides 7/8/9 was hard to read and footnotes overlapped the content.
root_cause: Dim text colors and footnotes that overlaid rather than flowed.
fix: Brightened the grey text, made footnotes flow below the legend, and auto-faded the arrow hint after 5s.

title: Pitch deck nav arrows un-positioned and wrong start slide
symptom: The pitch deck did not start at slide 1 and the nav arrows were not centered at the sides.
root_cause: An 'all:unset' declared after 'position:fixed' un-positioned the arrows (CSS order matters).
fix: Reordered the CSS so arrows are centered and the deck starts at slide 1.

title: READY tiles stay dark on the light theme
symptom: Some cards showed as black while others were white (READY tiles dark on the light theme).
root_cause: The theme token fix missed the dark .card-veil overlay.
fix: Applied the token fix to the .card-veil overlay so tiles match the theme.

title: Review-phase placeholder shows 'Building…' while awaiting approval
symptom: The review phase displayed a 'Building…' placeholder while it was actually awaiting user approval.
root_cause: The placeholder text did not distinguish the awaiting-approval state.
fix: Corrected the review-phase placeholder to reflect the awaiting-approval state.

title: Six preview render/display complaints
symptom: Category leak on a booking app, barber photo reading as a living room, toy-like toggle proportions, tab-bar labels wrapping, and settings labels ellipsizing.
root_cause: Multiple control-spec and layout issues across preview rendering.
fix: Fixed all six in code to researched control specs and encoded each as a rule in BUILD.md.

title: Stat numbers spilling over and jumbled
symptom: Numbers in stat chips spilled over and looked jumbled.
root_cause: Stat chips were not wrap-proof.
fix: Rebuilt the stat chips as wrap-proof primitives and recorded the rule as law.

title: Wrong hue value on the render wall
symptom: The render wall used a wrong hue.
root_cause: A hue value of 30 was incorrect.
fix: Set the warm color 0xFFD38C45 so all three render modes and dark mode render correctly.

title: Dev-server port mismatch in launch.json
symptom: The preview tooling couldn't attach to the dev server.
root_cause: The dev server binds 5197 but launch.json specified 5199.
fix: Corrected the port in launch.json.

title: Exported Android build fails: missing gradle.properties useAndroidX
symptom: The exported Android project failed its first-run compile in the farm.
root_cause: gradle.properties lacked android.useAndroidX=true.
fix: Added the one-line android.useAndroidX=true to gradle.properties and rebuilt.

title: Excessive agency for AI features
symptom: An AI agent is given more tools, permissions or autonomy than its task needs, and can act without approval.
root_cause: OWASP LLM: broad tools/permissions = attack surface.
fix: Least-privilege tools, scoped permissions, and human approval before irreversible or outward actions.

title: Improper LLM output handling
symptom: Model output rendered or executed without validation, enabling XSS, SSRF, path traversal or code execution downstream.
root_cause: OWASP LLM: outputs aren't validated before hitting other components.
fix: Validate/sanitize model output before rendering, running, or passing it to another system; treat it as untrusted.

title: Insecure or deprecated cryptography
symptom: Weak algorithms (MD5/SHA1 for passwords, ECB mode, hard-coded IV/salt, low KDF iterations).
root_cause: AI often picks a familiar-but-wrong primitive (CWE-327).
fix: Use a vetted KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 or PBKDF2 >=600k), random per-record salt/IV, AEAD ciphers.

title: Log injection / unsanitized logging
symptom: User input written to logs unescaped (CWE-117), enabling forged log entries or downstream injection.
root_cause: AI logs raw input for 'debuggability'.
fix: Sanitize/encode values before logging; never log secrets.

title: Missing authorization / IDOR (object-level access)
symptom: Endpoints check authentication but not that the caller owns the specific record (broken object-level authorization).
root_cause: AI wires up CRUD without per-object ownership checks.
fix: Enforce per-object ownership on every read/write; never trust an id from the client as proof of access.

title: Missing input sanitization / validation
symptom: The single most common flaw in AI-generated code — inputs used unsanitized in queries, HTML, filesystem or commands.
root_cause: LLMs default to the happy path and omit validation; ~45% of AI code fails security tests.
fix: Validate + sanitize every external input at the boundary; allow-list, not deny-list.

title: No rate limiting on expensive / AI endpoints
symptom: Unauthenticated or unthrottled endpoints that call paid AI / browser-rendering / email can be run up into a billing DoS.
root_cause: AI scaffolds endpoints without throttles.
fix: Per-IP/user rate limits + auth/turnstile on any endpoint that costs money or compute.

title: Prompt injection (direct and indirect)
symptom: Untrusted input (user text or content fetched from a page/doc/email) overrides the model's instructions or drives actions.
root_cause: OWASP LLM #1; observed content is data, not commands.
fix: Treat all tool/observed content as untrusted; separate instructions from data; confirm side-effectful actions; don't act on instructions found in content.

title: Secrets committed / exposed to the client
symptom: API keys, tokens or private keys in source, client bundles or the repo (400+ found across vibe-coded apps).
root_cause: AI inlines secrets to make examples 'work'.
fix: Keep secrets server-side in env bindings; never ship them to the browser; scan the tree + git history.

title: SQL / NoSQL injection from string-built queries
symptom: Queries assembled by concatenating user input instead of parameterized.
root_cause: Classic CWE-89; common in AI-generated data-access code.
fix: Always use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never string-concatenate user input into a query.

title: XSS from unescaped output rendered to HTML
symptom: User/model data written into the DOM without encoding — ~86% of AI-generated samples fail XSS defence.
root_cause: AI code interpolates strings straight into innerHTML/templates.
fix: Escape on output (incl. quotes) or use textContent; add a Content-Security-Policy as defence-in-depth.

title: Happy-path assumption — no null/undefined guards
symptom: AI code assumes API/optional data is always present and dereferences it, crashing on the empty/error case.
fix: Guard every optional/awaited value before use; handle the empty and error branches explicitly.

title: Floating promises / unhandled async errors
symptom: Promises not awaited or lacking catch, so failures are silent and ordering is wrong.
fix: Await or .catch every promise; surface async errors; avoid fire-and-forget for state changes.

title: Hard-coded environment-specific values
symptom: localhost URLs, absolute paths, ports or keys baked in that break outside the author's machine.
fix: Read config from env; no machine-specific literals in shipped code.

title: No error handling on network calls
symptom: fetch/HTTP calls with no try/catch, timeout or retry, so a blip becomes a broken UI.
fix: Wrap network calls with try/catch + timeout + a user-visible fallback; retry idempotent reads.

title: Silent catch swallowing errors
symptom: catch blocks that do nothing, hiding real failures and making bugs invisible.
fix: Handle or surface every caught error; never swallow silently.

title: +feature truncation swallows text and skips redaction
symptom: The `+feature` command read a fixed 60 characters, swallowing the rest of the sentence, and the swallowed text bypassed redaction (secret-leak risk).
root_cause: A fixed 60-char read plus the swallowed remainder never passing through the redactor.
fix: Read the full text and route it through redaction, using exact-match so tokens like `#bug` can't be swallowed.

title: Recovery codes hashed inconsistently
symptom: Valid recovery codes could fail because hashing was inconsistent.
root_cause: Recovery codes were hashed inconsistently between generation and verification.
fix: Hash recovery codes consistently.

title: Docs not synced
symptom: Docs weren't reliably persisted/synced.
root_cause: There was no synced docs store.
fix: Added a proper synced `docs` table and fixed the size cap.

title: `>cursor` builder-switch token silently discarded
symptom: A `>cursor` builder switch inside a captured prompt was silently dropped.
root_cause: An undefined template-literal segment (rendering as `undefined}`) discarded the `>cursor` token.
fix: Fixed the parsing so the builder-switch token is preserved.

title: Capture-bar quick chips don't update the prompt placeholder
symptom: Clicking a quick builder chip in the capture bar didn't update the 'What did you just ask X for?' message or switch the builder; only opening 'More' did.
root_cause: The quick chips lacked the handler that updates the placeholder and sets the active builder.
fix: Added selectCaptureBuilder() so a chip updates the placeholder in place (preserving typed text) and sets the builder.

title: Inconsistent text normalization
symptom: Normalization behaved inconsistently across paths.
root_cause: Normalization logic differed between code paths.
fix: Made normalization consistent.

title: Settings card can't read subscription periodEnd
symptom: The settings card read periodEnd but received nothing.
root_cause: publicUser didn't expose periodEnd.
fix: Exposed periodEnd on publicUser so the settings card can show the subscription period.

title: Trail outcome filter is a dead control
symptom: Clicking the trail's outcome filter (All/worked/almost/didn't-work) did nothing.
root_cause: `trail-filter` had no handler at all.
