root_cause: endCall always routed to the manual outcome panel (S.ui.pendingOutcome) and only then ran the recap; nothing inferred the outcome from the words that were captured.
fix: endCall skips the picker when at least 25 characters of real speech exist and calls summariseCall with auto:true; the recap prompt returns the outcome enum, a tidied transcript and any meeting as JSON; the recap shows the inferred outcome as an editable select and a change rewrites the logged attempt. The picker remains only for calls with no words.

title: One booked meeting rendered two or three times in Today > Meetings
symptom: A meeting auto-booked from a call appeared up to three times with slightly different titles.
root_cause: calEvents() merges the real S.cal.events entry with a derived reminder for lead.next (id d_<leadId>, title 'Name - label'). upcomingMeetings() de-duplicated by title, so the same meeting at the same minute counted twice.
fix: De-duplicate on leadId plus minute (Math.round(ts/60000)) instead of title. Verified: six rows collapsed to two, and a clean demo shows one row.

title: 'Do next' sorted only by due date: a new action set for 3 days sank to the bottom and 'Today' could not be chosen
symptom: The user added a next action and it landed at the bottom of the list; the New follow-up modal offered Tomorrow as the earliest option.
root_cause: nextStream() was a plain sort on next.due with no notion of when the action was created, save-followup never stamped a created time, and the quick chips started at 1 day.
fix: Bucket overdue, then today, then upcoming; within today the newest action first; save-followup stamps next.setAt; a Today chip was added. Verified in the live Do-next view.

title: Dialer dropped the contact's role: leadNumbers read pr.role but the contact form stores pr.title
symptom: Numbers belonging to additional people on a client showed no role label in the dialer.
root_cause: Field-name mismatch between the contact editor (title) and leadNumbers (role); nothing errored, the label was simply empty.
fix: leadNumbers reads pr.title with pr.role as fallback and now sorts the starred main number first (a main-number star was added to the contact block and honoured by the dialer and WhatsApp).

title: Anything kept under S.ui is lost on reload because save() destructures ui away (third incident: chosen theme)
symptom: A named theme chosen in Settings reverted after a reload. The same root cause had already wiped a running work timer on refresh and the selected call lead (the calls screen then showed another company's history).
root_cause: window.save() persists const { ui, account, sync, ...rest } = S, so every preference written to S.ui is memory-only; features keep putting user choices there because it is the convenient place for view state.
fix: bgTheme moved to S.settings (persisted); live timers are persisted under a liveTimers key and restored by resumeTimers; the call lead is persisted. House rule: S.ui is ephemeral view state only, any user-chosen setting belongs in S.settings.

title: A4 note page overflowed its own paper: explicit min-height stopped the flex item growing with its content
symptom: In the full-page note editor the text ran past the bottom of the 1123px sheet (scrollHeight 1370) so the page-break bands no longer matched the text.
root_cause: A flex item with overflow visible normally has min-height:auto (its content size), but the explicit min-height:1123px replaced that automatic minimum, so with flex-shrink:1 the sheet shrank to 1123px while the content stayed 1370px.
fix: .note-page{flex:none} so the sheet grows with its content; verified a 1478px page with no overflow and a visible page break.

title: Duplicate global definitions silently shadow each other: clientMeetingsCard in two files, two case 'mark-sent' labels, two onboarding flows
symptom: A new client-page Meetings card was written, deployed and 'verified' present in the source, yet never rendered because projects.js (loaded later) already defines window.clientMeetingsCard; a second case 'mark-sent' in the same switch was dead code; a copy edit to the sign-up name placeholder landed in signin.js while app.js renders the live onboarding.
root_cause: Dozens of script files share flat window.* globals and one large data-act switch. The later assignment (or earlier case label) wins with no warning, node --check passes, and typeof-guarded call sites (typeof X==='function' ? X(l) : '') hide which copy runs. Two sessions had also been building overlapping prompts in the same repo.
fix: Removed the dead duplicate and its CSS and handlers after finding that projects.js already owns the feature (Add meeting modal, attended meetings auto-log to the worklog, calendar mirror), reconciled mark-sent into one handler, and surfaced call-booked meetings inside the existing card instead. Rule: grep for window.<name> = and case '<act>' across public/*.js before adding.

title: 'Say a first hello' prompt stayed after a call was logged
symptom: A lead that had just been called remained in 'To reach out' with the first-hello prompt.
root_cause: saveAttempt() only advanced a lead off stage new for interested or booked outcomes and never set firstTouch for other attempts.
fix: Any logged call attempt sets firstTouch and moves new to messaged (never downgrading a later stage). Verified on a new-stage lead: it moved to the waiting bucket and the prompt disappeared. Note this also treats a no-answer attempt as a contact attempt.

title: Demo seed edits never reach returning visitors: decorateDemo only fills missing fields and demo state is cached in localStorage
symptom: After swapping the demo portraits the live demo still showed the old stock photos; only localStorage.clear() revealed the change. Seeding a new demo meeting had the same limitation.
root_cause: decorateDemo(st) sets lead, contact and user photos only when absent and the cached demo state is reloaded verbatim, so changes to seed data never reach anyone with a prior demo visit.
fix: Verified each change by clearing storage and reloading with a fresh query. The durable fix (a demoSeedVersion stamp compared on boot to re-decorate or re-seed) was not shipped in this session.

title: Verification traps in the Hallalu SPA made working code look broken and broken code look fine
symptom: (a) Replacing window.S with buildSeedState() broke the defineProperty getters for leads and todos, so calEvents threw on forEach of undefined; (b) a forced save() left onboarded:false so the next load landed on onboarding and 'the Meetings section is missing'; (c) changing only the #hash of portal.html does not re-run decode(), so the old card stayed on screen; (d) the static python preview has no worker routing so /app 404s; (e) fetching the new ?v= asset URL before the deploy finished left a stale copy in the cache so the resizer and frame X looked absent until ?v= was bumped again.
root_cause: State is a getter-backed object shared by dozens of scripts, portal.html decodes location.hash once at boot, and assets are cache-busted only by the ?v=N query.
fix: Mutate S in place or run localStorage.clear() then load /app?demo=1&fresh=<timestamp>; use a full reload for hash changes; use wrangler dev or the live URL (not the static server) for worker routes; never fetch a versioned asset URL before the deploy completes and bump ?v= again if you did.

title: Etsy shows connected but syncs nothing: x-api-key was sent as keystring:shared_secret
symptom: The user entered their Etsy keys, OAuth succeeded, and the sync reported 'Synced 0 and 0' with no listings or orders.
root_cause: etsyGet built the x-api-key header as keystring + ':' + shared_secret whenever a shared secret was saved. Etsy v3 expects the keystring only, so every data call was rejected after OAuth had succeeded. Shop-id extraction from /users/{id}/shops was also brittle.
fix: x-api-key is the keystring only; a pickShop() helper extracts the shop id defensively; the sync returns diagnostics and the client explains a connected-but-empty result instead of printing 'Synced 0 and 0'; the shared-secret field is labelled as not needed.

title: Monthly goal widget ignored revenue and orders goals and edited the wrong month
symptom: After adding a goal the dashboard widget still said 'Set a monthly goal'.
root_cause: The dashboard widget only checked goal.profit, and editGoal() edited the Money view's filter month instead of the month the dashboard shows (thisMonth()). The word 'goal' also meant four different things (Studio listing challenge, Routine, Dashboard, Money), so users could not tell which one they had set.
fix: The widget honours profit, revenue or orders; editGoal takes the month it was opened for; a Today's goal card now leads the dashboard and a monthly-goal card sits on Money; the Studio copy reads 'New listings to publish in October 2026' with a plain explanation of monthly goal versus daily challenge.

title: Paste-a-link fallback through keyless reader proxies cannot get past Etsy's 403 from Cloudflare egress
symptom: Etsy listing URLs return 403 to the Worker; the planned fallback (allorigins, codetabs, Jina reader) looked right in code and was assumed to work.
root_cause: Probed from real Cloudflare egress with wrangler dev --remote: direct 403, allorigins and codetabs time out, Jina 403. Probing from the local network was unrepresentative because it was also blocked. Only a keyed scraper (Firecrawl, as Hallalu uses) works.
fix: Firecrawl first when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set, keyless proxies kept as best-effort with short timeouts, and the import copy says Etsy needs the key. Lesson: prove a fallback from the production egress before shipping it.

title: Starter posts added after a user's first visit never appear: a single boolean seeded flag gates seeding
symptom: New sample carousels (navy edition, the Bug Ledger, Pixelbake and Aprizely starter sets, versions 4 and 5) did not show for anyone who had already opened PostPlan.
root_cause: Boot state is { projects: [], calendar: [], seeded: false }; once seeded is true the SAMPLES list is never consulted again.
fix: Seed by id: each starter registers under its id and boot adds any SAMPLES id that is missing from state (commit 'seed starters by id', then versions 4 and 5 registered).

title: compose.mjs headless-Chrome render has no timeout and a shared profile, so one wedged render stalls a whole creative run
symptom: Renders stopped on the second image in two sessions (600s tool timeouts, runs pushed to the background, leftover chrome-apz-compose processes); a carousel export using --allow-file-access hung until a fresh profile was used.
root_cause: execFileSync(CHROME, ['--headless=new', ...]) has no timeout or kill and reuses a default or fixed user-data-dir, so another session's headless Chrome or a stale profile lock makes the next launch hang.
fix: Fresh mkdtemp user-data-dir per render, a hard timeout (perl alarm because macOS has no timeout command), up to four retries, the target PNG removed before each try, own stale chrome processes killed first. Nine slides then exported in a loop with per-slide exit status.

title: Free model dreamshaper-8-lcm returned an all-black PNG, reported success and charged a credit
symptom: pxb gen --model dreamshaper-8-lcm printed a success line (0 Neurons, 1 credit) and wrote a 768x768 file that was a black frame.
root_cause: Not isolated. The bake path returns whatever bytes the model produced and has no blank-image check, so an empty frame takes the normal success and billing path.
fix: Worked around by using flux-2-dev once credits allowed. Recommended: reject near-uniform output server-side (mean luminance and variance), refund the credit and return an error.

title: 402 'Top up in Settings' names no account, so a CLI on the @seven test account looked like the topped-up @rhe account was empty
symptom: Three parallel flux-2-dev bakes failed 'You need 42 credits for this bake and have 4' right after the user said they had topped up; project images were baked and filed on @seven; pxb balance is an unknown command.
root_cause: ~/.pixelbake.json held the test account token (the house rule says @rhe). The 402 text and CLI output never show the handle, and the only identity check is a separate whoami.
fix: Found the mismatch with whoami and stats (@seven, 4 credits) and told the user which account held the credit. Recommended: 402 body and CLI error include {handle, balance, needed}, a pxb balance alias, and a whoami-must-be-@rhe check at the start of any task that makes images.

title: Brand brief drafted from a JS-rendered site saw only the empty HTML shell and invented a grey, corporate brand
symptom: Marketing-from-URL for a client-rendered site drafted a brief with guessed grey palette, corporate audience and generic style instead of the real brand.
root_cause: The brief drafter reads server HTML only; the target page was a roughly 1.8 KB shell whose content is rendered by JavaScript.
fix: Corrected palette, audience, style and the six concepts through the briefs API (PATCH /api/briefs) before spending any credits. Recommended: detect a near-empty page, render it with a browser fetch, or warn 'I only saw N characters, check the brief' before the first bake.

title: Native BotView.whenText printed the literal source (Int(r.stopPct)) instead of the number
symptom: The iPhone and Mac strategy-bot rule text showed raw interpolation code in place of the stop percentage.
root_cause: The Swift string used (Int(r.stopPct)) without the leading backslash, so it is plain text; it compiles and passes the build.
fix: Added the missing backslash; the native build is green; found while porting the plain-English explainer to native.

title: 1,433 Xcode build products under native/build were committed to git
symptom: git status listed 1,433 tracked deletions under native/build after a clean build directory.
root_cause: No .gitignore entry for native/build, so an earlier git add -A captured derived data.
fix: Removed the files from the index and added native/build/ to .gitignore (history still holds the blobs; the repo is local only).

title: simctl defaults write seeds the wrong domain: the iOS app never sees the injected token while read-back 'works'
symptom: A seeded auth token read back correctly but the native app always showed the login screen.
root_cause: xcrun simctl spawn booted defaults write targets the simulator's global preferences, while UserDefaults.standard lives in the app's data container (Library/Preferences/<bundle>.plist).
fix: Resolve the container with simctl get_app_container booted <bundle> data, write the plist there, then relaunch so bootstrap() reads it. (A later hang was the disk-starved simulator, not the code.)

title: Smoke tests ran against the wrong app because a 200 from localhost:<port> was another project's dev server
symptom: The Pixelbake Teams UI walk printed a tick for every screen with page titles 'undefined' and a console error from '[abba]'; elsewhere preview_start refused ports 8791 (joy-cloud) and 8812 (postplan) held by other chats.
root_cause: Fixed ports in launch.json are shared by concurrent sessions and the harness only checked HTTP status.
fix: Moved the harness to a free port (5231) and asserted a page marker (title or handle) before trusting any screenshot; check lsof -iTCP:<port> or use autoPort before starting.

title: A hidden Browser pane gives blank screenshots and timeouts that were mistaken for page defects
symptom: Screenshots of SkillSea, Hallalu and the finish verification came back blank or timed out with 'pane is not displayed'; a tab pinned to a local file preview refused navigation; the Aprizely board tab kept taking focus.
root_cause: A hidden pane does not composite frames, and a pinned tab cannot navigate.
fix: When the pane is hidden verify through DOM and text (find, read_page, get_page_text) and say so; open a new tab instead of navigating a pinned one; front the app tab before screenshots.

title: Full-disk state is misdiagnosed: sealed-snapshot df, unwritable tool output and a blocking shell update prompt
symptom: Bash commands looked failed with no output; df showed 12Gi used and 0 free on a 228Gi disk; a terminal tab sat on an oh-my-zsh 'Would you like to update? [Y/n]' prompt; a read-only df was denied by the classifier as a false positive.
root_cause: The harness writes each command's output to a /private/tmp file, so ENOSPC makes every command appear to fail even when it ran. On APFS the sealed system snapshot makes df / meaningless. The oh-my-zsh prompt blocks that tab until answered.
fix: Check /System/Volumes/Data (5.7 GiB free while the snapshot showed 630 MiB), free regenerable caches first (npm, wrangler, pip), set DISABLE_UPDATE_PROMPT=true for agent terminals, and retry a denied read-only command with a different tool.

title: LLM replies shown in plain-text surfaces carry literal ** markers and ```json fences
symptom: Hallalu recap emails opened with '**Here's a quick recap:**' under a second recap header; Abba's Ask Ava showed asterisks around bold words; /api/ai with a JSON-only prompt returned text starting with a ```json fence.
root_cause: System prompts did not forbid markdown and the clients render model text through textarea or textContent.
fix: The recap prompt now demands plain text with no markdown and a single recap header; Abba added a small bold and italic renderer for Ava output; the client JSON extractor strips fences. The portal Ava draft path was not checked for fence handling.

title: The definition-of-done skill committed and deployed but never pushed: eight commits sat unpushed until the user asked
symptom: On Hallalu a finish pass found eight unpushed commits on main (v264 to v271) after the work had been reported as finished; the user separately asked that /finish also push.
root_cause: The /finish ritual covered commit and deploy only, with no push step and no rule for repos that have no remote (SkillSea and Evertrue were local-only until a remote was created).
fix: The /finish description and checklist now say pushed to git; if there is no remote, say so and skip rather than leave a pushable commit behind. Evertrue was given a private GitHub remote.

title: Bulk edit missed 16 of 35 analyses: the ANALYSES array mixes single-quoted JS and double-quoted JSON entry styles
symptom: A first pass baked and wired hero images into 19 analyses and the grep count looked complete (19/19), but the live DOM showed 35 cards with 16 still lacking a thumbnail.
root_cause: worker.js ANALYSES holds two object styles: hand-written JS entries (slug: 'x') and JSON-style entries appended by publish scripts ("slug": "x"). The discovery regex and the grep -c anchored on one style only, so the inventory was silently partial.
fix: Counted both styles (grep -c '"slug":'), baked and wired the second set anchored after each "slug": line with matching quoting, node --check, then verified against rendered output (querySelectorAll count: 35/35 thumbs, 0 broken) instead of trusting the grep count.

title: zsh: using `path` as a read/loop variable overwrites $PATH, so every later command is 'command not found: git/curl'
symptom: A verification loop (`while IFS=$'\t' read -r slug path; do git show HEAD:worker.js ...`) printed 'command not found: git' on every iteration and reported all 34 images 'missing'; a second session's `path=${pair#*:}` loop then broke curl the same way. The misleading output was first dismissed as a 'PATH quirk'.
root_cause: In zsh, `path` is a special array tied to $PATH (as are fpath, cdpath, manpath, module_path). Assigning to a variable named path replaces PATH for the rest of that shell/function, so external commands stop resolving.
fix: Rename the variable (pth, rel, p2). When 'command not found' appears for a command that worked seconds earlier, echo $PATH before debugging anything else. Hit in two separate sessions on 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-01.

title: Live board showed no per-wave time on any board without (~Nm) tokens because tasks carried no start/done timestamps
symptom: After a per-wave/total ETA feature shipped, normal boards (no (~25m) token in labels) still showed no per-wave time, which looked like 'the old version is still running' even though the feature was committed and deployed.
root_cause: The display only parsed (~25m) tokens from labels. The worklog row stored only board-level started/updated/finished, so real elapsed time per wave could not be computed.
fix: Server now stamps startedAt/doneAt onto each task inside the existing tasks JSON as statuses change (merged by index from the previous row, no D1 migration); the board derives per-wave real elapsed; /api/agent/report pulls the same stamped timestamps so the published report groups the timeline by wave with real times. Proven live on a token-less board.

title: Board time was misleading: flat 15m/task estimate beside seconds of real work, and an idle active wave kept its real clock ticking (22m for a 5s step)
symptom: A 5-second wave read '~30m' and the header claimed '~1h est' for seconds of work; a demo board left with an active wave showed 22m 14s of 'real' time long after nothing was happening.
root_cause: Auto-estimate used a fixed 15 minutes per task, never learning from completed tasks; the elapsed clock used Date.now() for any non-finished board, so abandoned boards inflated forever.
fix: Adaptive ETA from the mean duration of completed tasks (in-progress task counts down), falling back to a (~Nm) token then the default; real clock freezes when the board has been idle more than 3 minutes since the last update; done waves show actual only, active shows actual + ~left, pending shows ~estimate. Verified live on the stale board (22m collapsed to 2s).

title: PUT /api/trades/:id rewrites every column, so a client sending a partial trade silently nulls the rest
symptom: While adding trade editing to the native iPhone/Mac apps, the Swift Trade model lacked media/best/worst/confidence columns; saving an edit from it would have wiped those fields in D1.
root_cause: The trades PUT handler is full-replace, not merge-safe, unlike the new strategies and lesson PUTs.
fix: Extended the native Trade struct to carry every column and built a lossless Store.tradeBody for edits; the new strategies and notes.lesson PUTs were made merge-safe (partial PUT keeps all other fields, proven by curl). Rule recorded: never send a partial trade.

title: pkill -x Abba also kills the iOS Simulator's Abba process (same executable name), which looked exactly like a Save crash
symptom: After relaunching the Mac build the iPhone simulator app dropped to the home screen right after Save; crash reports and log show found nothing, and the identical Save path then worked three times with a log stream attached.
root_cause: pkill -x matches the process name system-wide, and the simulator app process is also named Abba, so the Mac relaunch step killed the simulator app mid-test.
fix: Terminate with xcrun simctl terminate <udid> <bundle-id> for the simulator and pkill -f '<build path>/Abba.app/Contents/MacOS/Abba' for the Mac binary; before chasing a 'crash' with no crash report, check whether your own cleanup command killed the app.

title: iPhone target failed to build on .onChange(of:){ _, v in } (iOS 17-only) while the Mac target compiled, after a commit had already claimed both builds green
symptom: xcodebuild -sdk iphonesimulator: 'onChange(of:initial:_:) is only available in iOS 17.0 or newer' at LessonsView.swift:118 and :148 (and StrategiesView); the macOS build of the same code succeeded, so the earlier commit message 'both targets build' was wrong.
root_cause: IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET is 16.0 but MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET is 14.0; the two-parameter onChange closure exists only on iOS 17+/macOS 14+, and only one target was built before committing.
fix: Switched to the single-parameter .onChange(of:) { v in } form; rebuilt BOTH targets (iphonesimulator and macosx) and corrected the claim in a follow-up commit. Build every target before saying 'builds green'.

title: App's own TimelineView type shadows SwiftUI.TimelineView, giving opaque compile errors ('extra trailing closure', 'no member periodic')
symptom: TradesView.swift:20 failed with 'extra trailing closure passed in call', 'type EnvironmentObject<Store> has no member periodic' and 'cannot infer contextual base .now' for a plain TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)).
root_cause: The app defines its own TimelineView screen, which shadows SwiftUI's in module scope, so the unqualified name resolves to the app type.
fix: Qualify as SwiftUI.TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)). Avoid naming app views after SwiftUI types (TimelineView, Section, Label, List).

title: Swift 'unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time' from a long string concatenation inside Text(...)
symptom: StrategiesView.swift:292 failed the Mac build with 'the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time' on a Text() built from optional map + string concatenations + String(format:).
root_cause: One expression mixing several optional .map closures, string concatenation and String(format:) overwhelms Swift's constraint solver.
fix: Extracted the pieces into a small helper statsLine(...) that builds the string step by step and passed the result to Text; build succeeded.

title: Native media URL hardcoded to production ignored the API base, so lesson and strategy screenshots showed grey placeholders against a local dev API
symptom: On the simulator pointed at a local wrangler dev (ABBA_BASE), lesson screenshots stayed placeholders although curl to the same /api/media/<key> returned 200 image/png; a grep afterwards found DashboardView.swift:274 still hardcoded as well.
root_cause: API.mediaURL() built https://abba.coconvo.workers.dev/api/media/<key> instead of deriving from the configurable base, so only some call sites followed the override.
fix: mediaURL now returns base.absoluteString + '/media/' + key and the remaining hardcoded builder was found by grep and routed through it; verified on the simulator.

title: Repo history carried 388 MB of native build artifacts (20 MB binaries) despite native/build/ being gitignored, discovered only at the first GitHub push
symptom: Creating the private remote and pushing was very slow; git count-objects showed size-pack 388 MiB and the five largest blobs were Abba.app executables under native/build/.
root_cause: Build products were committed before the .gitignore rule existed, and the ignore rule never removed them from history.
fix: Push still worked (no file near 100 MB) and the history rewrite was left as the owner's call; recommended git-filter-repo --path native/build --invert-paths. Before a first push run: git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check | sort by size.

title: Theme count was stale in six places after adding Sunset/Sunrise (code 17, README 14, tagline 16, gallery cards 16/14, theme-studio README 16)
symptom: abba-backgrounds.js had 17 themes while its README said 14, modules.json (root and public) and both index.html gallery cards said 16 and the theme-studio README said 16.
root_cause: Counts are hand-typed in the header comment, README, two modules.json copies and the gallery cards, and drift on every theme added.
fix: Updated all six places (14/16 to 17, later 18) and re-validated both JSON files; the durable fix is to derive the number from AbbaBackgrounds.list().length at publish time instead of typing it.

title: Module change committed by a sibling session but never deployed: live served mixed versions of the same feature
symptom: Live abba-backgrounds.js contained Sunset but live theme-studio.js lacked the new rename control and the catalog tagline still said 16, while git HEAD already had the .js changes.
root_cause: Commit was treated as done; the sibling session pushed the .js edits without running wrangler deploy for the modules Worker.
fix: Deployed with wrangler@4.28.1 and verified by curl-grepping a unique marker in each live asset (id: 'sunset', data-e, 'The 18 background themes'), instead of trusting git status.

title: pxb gen --ref with a reference id owned by another account returns a bare 404 'Reference image not found in your library'
symptom: Six FLUX.2 dev re-bakes failed with '/api/generate -> 404 Reference image not found in your library' even though the reference existed.
root_cause: The reference was uploaded under the rhe account but the bakes ran with the seven account token; the error does not say the id belongs to a different account.
fix: Re-ran with the token that owns the reference (PIXELBAKE_TOKEN per call) and uploaded the ref to the second account for later runs; the CLI should name the account mismatch in the 404 message.

title: Countdown hero's corner edit pencil was invisible over the photo and silently wiped the due date with no confirmation
symptom: User could not find an edit button on the countdown, and tapping the hidden corner pencil reset the due date instantly.
root_cause: The only edit affordance sat over the hero photo with low contrast and its handler cleared S.baby.due directly instead of opening an editor or asking first.
fix: Added a visible Edit countdown pill that opens a sheet (name, date, gender) with every reset behind a confirm, plus a confirmed 'close this chapter quietly' path; verified cancel keeps all data.

title: Photo wallpaper sized with background-size: zoom*100% letterboxed instead of covering the viewport
symptom: A landscape photo behind a portrait viewport left empty bands at the top and bottom, so the wallpaper did not take up 100% of the background.
root_cause: background-size as a percentage sets width only (height auto), so any image whose aspect differs from the viewport leaves gaps.
fix: Use cover as the baseline and switch to zoom*100% only when zoom is above 1; ported the same rule to Happy Travel, Ever After and Planner Studio and verified bgIsCover in all four.

title: Baby Tree orbit labels collided: members on adjacent rings stacked on the same spoke and parents sat over the baby's name
symptom: Names such as Mum and Nana, and Dad, Grandpa Joe, Uncle Sam and Tom overlapped on the concentric rings.
root_cause: Angles were evenly spaced from the top with only ri*0.4 rad per-ring drift, so inner and outer members lined up radially, and long labels had no width cap.
fix: Ring 0 starts at 180 degrees so parents flank the baby left and right, outer rings fan from the top with a per-ring offset of pi/7, avatars shrink on outer rings, labels are single-line with ellipsis on soft backing chips.

title: Hero filler image picked from a remembered Unsplash ID showed the wrong subject, and a hand-edited Wikimedia thumbnail width returned no image
symptom: The 'pregnant belly' default loaded baby feet in a blanket, two other remembered IDs failed, and swapping /1920px- for /1400px- in a Wikimedia Commons thumb URL gave naturalWidth 0.
root_cause: Photo IDs recalled from memory were never rendered and checked; Wikimedia only serves the thumbnail widths it has generated, so a hand-edited width 404s.
fix: Queried the Wikimedia Commons API, auditioned six candidates in an on-page grid, used the exact URL the API returned (verified HTTP 200 and image loads) and noted a licence swap before commercial launch.

title: git filter-branch run from a repo subdirectory silently did nothing because stderr was discarded; 12 trailers survived in one repo
symptom: A four-repo loop rewrote three repos but PlannerStudio/webapp still showed 12 Co-Authored-By trailers on main; the loop printed no error.
root_cause: filter-branch requires the repo top level ('You need to run this command from the toplevel of the working tree'); PlannerStudio's .git is at ~/PlannerStudio, one level above the webapp folder the loop cd'd into, and the loop redirected 2>&1 to /dev/null.
fix: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" before filter-branch; verify with `git log main --grep` (not --all, which also counts refs/original backups) and never blanket-discard stderr on destructive history operations.

title: git push --force-with-lease rejected with 'stale info' after filter-branch -- --all, reflog expire and gc
symptom: All four rewritten repos failed to push main with '[rejected] main -> main (stale info)'.
root_cause: filter-branch --all rewrote the local refs/remotes/origin/* too, so the lease's expected value no longer matched the real remote tip.
fix: For these solo, user-authorised repos used plain git push --force and verified origin/main (0 trailers, same commit counts); in shared repos capture the old SHA first and use --force-with-lease=main:<old-sha>.

title: npx --no-install wrangler deploy fails for a project pinning a wrangler version that is not installed locally, and a grep-filtered deploy hid the failure
symptom: Aprizely's SEO tag deploy printed nothing useful under grep -iE 'Uploaded|Deployed|Version ID'; re-running showed 'npx canceled due to missing packages and no YES option: wrangler@4.145.0'.
root_cause: --no-install refuses the pinned wrangler that is not in node_modules, and the output filter only matched success words, so the failure looked like an empty success.
fix: Use npx --yes wrangler deploy (or install the pinned version) and include 'error|✘' in the grep; confirm a Current Version ID line before saying deployed.

title: 14 of 39 apps had no git remote (9) or no git at all (5) and 7 live Workers had no local source, so one disk loss destroys them
symptom: A portfolio deploy sweep found kindly, patentcake, payrails, paystudy and pitchdecks with no repo, ABS, evertrue, gitbagel, joy, skillsea, traderjournal, birthdaytreat and two marketing repos with no remote, and hopefil, coconvo-ai, listing-lab, listing-lab-pro, social-levelup and two safe-haven Workers deployed with no source on this machine.
root_cause: Apps were created ad hoc and some were kept local-only on purpose, with no inventory comparing local folders, git remotes and the live Workers list; a disk wipe had already destroyed one checkout.
fix: Inventory script (dirs x git status x ahead/behind x workers_list) surfaced them; owner chose to import the orphans into GitBagel and an importer was written, but it needs the owner's gb_session. Recommend a remote for every deployed Worker.

title: Scanner INVIS-HIDDEN flags legitimate U+00A0 placeholders, a deliberate BOM stripper and thin-space number formatting as smuggled Unicode
symptom: finished-app produced INVIS-HIDDEN highs at Notes.tsx:135-140 (U+00A0 in JSX {p.content || ' '}), PinPad.tsx:50, calc.ts:226 (thin space) and kindle.ts:11 (intentional BOM strip); all were false positives after a codepoint-level read.
root_cause: The detector treats any non-ASCII whitespace as suspicious instead of limiting to zero-width, bidi-control and invisible format characters.
fix: Triaged as false positives with the exact codepoints; detector should flag only U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2060-2064 and a mid-file U+FEFF, and allow U+00A0/U+202F/U+2009 inside JSX text and string literals.

title: heart-bell MutationObserver observed its own innerHTML write: infinite microtask loop froze any app on load
symptom: Abba (and any app embedding the shared heart-bell module) hung silently on load when authenticated: main thread pegged, no console error, logged-out view fine.
root_cause: heart-bell.js observed document.body with {subtree:true}; its paintAll() sets innerHTML on a node inside body, so the observer fired on its own mutation and re-queued paintAll forever (microtask loop, never yields to paint).
fix: disconnect() the observer around every write and re-observe after, plus a requestAnimationFrame debounce; shipped as module v1 to v2 and redeployed modules.coconvo. General rule: never let an observer's callback write inside the subtree it observes without disconnecting first.

title: Emoji-to-icon sweep injected ${ic()} template placeholders into quoted (non-template) strings
symptom: After a scripted emoji to SVG icon sweep, some buttons/labels rendered the literal text '${ic(...)}' instead of an icon.
root_cause: The sweep replaced emoji everywhere with a template-literal call, but a share of the emoji sat inside single/double-quoted strings, where ${} is not interpolated.
fix: Regex pass restricted to backtick strings, and a post-sweep grep for the literal '${ic(' inside non-template quotes; convert those strings to concatenation. Always grep for the injected token's literal form after a mass replace.

title: StudioTTS.stop was undefined: voice 'stop' wiring threw on tts.speak/stop alias mismatch
symptom: Pressing stop on spoken lessons threw TypeError (StudioTTS.stop is not a function) and audio kept playing.
root_cause: The studio-voices module exported speak/cancel but callers (tts.js, lessons UI) invoked stop; no alias existed, and the call sat in an event handler so the error was swallowed.
fix: Add stop as an alias of cancel in the module and guard callers with typeof checks; add a smoke test that every public method name used by callers exists on the module object.

title: Vision watchlist hallucinated tickers: model-extracted symbols were added without validation
symptom: Uploading a chart/screenshot to build a watchlist added symbols that were never in the image (and some that do not exist).
root_cause: Vision model output was trusted as a ticker list; models complete plausible-looking tickers.
fix: Validate every extracted symbol against the real price feed (candle/quote lookup) before it is offered, and make the watchlist add confirm-first (user ticks the symbols to keep). Treat model-extracted identifiers as untrusted until resolved against a source of truth.

title: '24/7 bots' claim was false: bots only ran while the browser tab was open
symptom: UI and copy promised bots that trade around the clock, but strategy evaluation lived entirely in the client; closing the tab stopped them.
root_cause: Evaluator ran in bot.js on a client interval; the Worker had no scheduled evaluator, so there was no server-side execution path.
fix: Add a Cloudflare cron trigger that evaluates enabled bots server-side against the same candle feed and records signals; until it exists, copy must say 'runs while Abba is open'. Do not ship an availability claim the architecture cannot meet.

title: Candle route regex rejected ETF/dotted/dashed tickers (400 on valid symbols)
symptom: Charts and bots returned 400 'bad symbol' for tickers such as BRK-B style or ETF symbols with punctuation.
root_cause: Symbol validation regex allowed only [A-Z]{1,5}; real instruments include '.', '-', '^', '=' (BRK-B, ^GSPC, EURUSD=X).
fix: Widen to a bounded allowlist class (letters, digits, . - ^ =) with a length cap, keep it anchored, and keep it SSRF-safe since the symbol is interpolated into an upstream URL (encodeURIComponent).

title: Ask Ava chat history was lost on every re-render
symptom: Opening another tab/theme change or any re-render cleared the Ask Ava conversation.
root_cause: The conversation lived in a DOM-local variable recreated by the view render function, not in app state.
fix: Hold messages in the app store (and persist to the docs/sync layer) and rebuild the DOM from it on each render.

title: mxPop ReferenceError after a scripted patch silently no-oped
symptom: A feature wired through a scripted String.replace patch threw 'mxPop is not defined' at runtime; the patch printed success.
root_cause: The patch anchor text did not match the file (shell quoting changed ${} / backslash / paren), so replace() returned the string unchanged and nothing was inserted, but later patches assumed it had landed.
fix: Scripted patches must assert the anchor exists (throw if src.includes(anchor) is false) and assert the output differs; prefer the Edit tool or a quoted heredoc ('EOF') for code containing $ ( \ characters.

title: Native trades PUT replaces the whole record: partial updates from iPhone/Mac dropped fields (not merge-safe)
symptom: Editing one field in the native app could blank other trade fields saved by the web app.
root_cause: API.swift sends a full-object PUT from a possibly stale local copy; the Worker replaces rather than merges.
fix: Send the complete freshly-fetched object, or add a server-side merge/PATCH; verify round-trip of every field in a cross-client test.

title: Sample-inbox seed never re-ran for returning sample users: sample accounts stayed empty after a data fix
symptom: After seeding logic was improved, anyone who had already entered sample mode saw old/empty data; only brand-new browsers saw the fix.
root_cause: seedSampleInbox() was guarded by a 'seeded once' flag stored with the user, so changes to the seed were never applied to existing sample users.
fix: Version the seed (seedVersion), and re-seed sample owners when the stored version is older; for real accounts never seed at all.

title: Sample product images were generated on demand at first view (slow, flaky, billed): precompute static-first
symptom: Sample gallery showed blank tiles for seconds and sometimes permanently when generation failed or rate-limited.
root_cause: Images were baked lazily per request instead of being shipped as static assets.
fix: Bake once, commit the files under public/, reference them by static URL; keep generation out of the user path entirely.

title: root.App.applyRings called before App existed: blank SPA on cold load
symptom: The whole app rendered blank on first load; console showed 'Cannot read properties of undefined (applyRings)'.
root_cause: A vendored module called root.App.applyRings at script-evaluation time, before app.js had assigned root.App (script order / IIFE timing).
fix: Call lazily inside render/after DOMContentLoaded and guard with root.App && root.App.applyRings; add a boot smoke test that fails on any uncaught error at load.

title: renderLanding assumed DOM nodes that do not exist in some states (null deref blanked the landing page)
symptom: Landing view threw on a missing element and rendered nothing for logged-out visitors in one state.
root_cause: Unconditional getElementById(...).addEventListener / .innerHTML on nodes absent from that template variant.
fix: Null-guard each lookup and render defensively; test every route logged-out and logged-in.

title: Routine/To-Do seeding wrote sample rows into REAL accounts
symptom: Real sellers opened the Routine/Checklist and found demo tasks they never created.
root_cause: The seed path keyed off 'no data yet' instead of 'is the sample owner', so any empty real account was seeded.
fix: Gate all demo seeding on the sample owner (?sample=1) only; migration to remove seeded rows from real accounts by id prefix.

title: Timetable empty days were not clickable: nowhere to add a block
symptom: Clicking an empty day in the timetable did nothing; users could only add blocks from days that already had one.
root_cause: Click handler was bound to rendered blocks, not to the day cell.
fix: Bind the add-block handler to the day cell (event delegation) and show an affordance on hover/focus.

title: Paste-a-link unfurl returned 403 for Etsy (bot-blocked): feature showed 'failed' with no fallback
symptom: Pasting an Etsy listing link produced an error; the product title/image were never filled.
root_cause: Server-side fetch of etsy.com is blocked by bot protection (403); the route treated any non-200 as failure.
fix: Treat 403 as 'site blocks automated fetch', fall back to parsing the URL slug for a title and ask the user to paste the details/CSV; never imply the link was verified.

title: Uploads froze in a hidden/background tab: requestAnimationFrame-driven pipeline never advanced
symptom: Import progress stalled at the first stage whenever the tab was not frontmost (including headless/background-pane tests).
root_cause: The page-render/upload pipeline awaited rAF callbacks, which browsers pause in hidden tabs.
fix: Use setTimeout/MessageChannel or a promise-based yield for pipeline steps; reserve rAF for visual updates only. Also front the tab when testing in the pane.

title: Dark fill band (shaded header strip) counted as a line: phantom fields and mis-snapped baselines
symptom: A solid shaded band was detected as many horizontal lines, producing a stack of phantom fields.
root_cause: Line detector used a global darkness threshold; a filled band satisfies 'dark run of N pixels' for every row.
fix: Add a local-contrast test (the line must differ from rows directly above and below) and cap line thickness; reject filled rectangles.

title: Round buttons, caption-as-title and letter-top phantom lines produced false fields
symptom: Radio/round buttons became text fields, a caption was used as the field title, and the tops of letters were detected as underlines.
root_cause: Pixel scanner had no shape classification and no minimum line length/aspect test relative to nearby text height.
fix: Classify near-square/round blobs as checkbox/radio, require line length >= several times local glyph height, and prefer the nearest label to the left/above rather than any caption.

title: Share link filled a stale fillable PDF: recipient saw the old document version
symptom: A sent signing/fill link showed an older copy of the form than the one the sender last edited.
root_cause: The link captured the PDF at creation time while edits were stored separately and never re-bound; the recipient route loaded the first file.
fix: Resolve the envelope's current file/version at open time and bump a revision; show the recipient the latest rendition, and block sending an envelope with unsaved edits.

title: pdf-lib flatten() left dangling /Annots references that other viewers rejected
symptom: Flattened exports opened in pdf.js but showed errors or blank pages in Preview/Acrobat.
root_cause: form.flatten() removes widgets from the AcroForm but pages kept /Annots entries pointing at deleted objects.
fix: After flatten, clear or filter each page's /Annots to only live refs, then save; verify the export in more than one viewer.

title: Export misplaced fields on rotated/cropped PDFs (off by ~330pt)
symptom: Fields filled in the editor landed far from their position in the downloaded PDF for pages with /Rotate or a non-zero CropBox.
root_cause: Placement used the MediaBox origin and ignored CropBox offset and /Rotate when mapping viewport coordinates to PDF user space.
fix: Map through the page's rotation and CropBox origin (translate then rotate); regression-tested on rotated/cropped pages, error 330pt to under 1pt.

title: Editor could not scroll: flex children shrank to viewport height and clipped the page
symptom: On long PDFs the editor canvas was clipped and no scrollbar appeared, so lower pages were unreachable.
root_cause: Page container was a flex child with default flex-shrink:1 and overflow hidden, so it shrank to the container instead of growing.
fix: flex:none (or min-height:0 on the scroller plus flex-shrink:0 on pages) so the scroll container owns the overflow.

title: Reasoning model timed out on field-labelling: default reasoning effort too high for a Worker request
symptom: AI label pass returned 504/timeouts on busy forms.
root_cause: Workers AI reasoning model ran at default reasoning effort; latency exceeded the request budget.
fix: Set reasoning_effort low, benchmark candidate models on the synthetic ground-truth form, and pick the fastest model that holds accuracy (non-reasoning vision model for this task).

title: Text-wish 'note' tab posted kind 'note' but the API only accepts 'text': silent 400, wish never saved
symptom: Friends typing a written wish saw it appear to submit, but nothing was stored.
root_cause: Client note tab sent kind:'note' while the Worker validates kind against an allowlist that has 'text'; the 400 was not surfaced in the UI.
fix: Map tab to kind 'text' on the client, share the kind enum between client and server tests, and always surface non-2xx responses to the user.

title: An empty/failed wish card broke the CSS multi-column masonry layout
symptom: One card with no media collapsed or spanned columns, pushing the rest of the wall out of alignment.
root_cause: Cards without content had zero height and the column-span/break rules did not apply; missing break-inside:avoid on the card.
fix: Skip rendering empty cards, set break-inside:avoid, and give every card a minimum height.

title: Flagship 'add your wish' action was below the fold on mobile
symptom: First-time visitors to a birthday link did not see how to post a wish without scrolling.
root_cause: Countdown/header hero consumed the full viewport.
fix: Pin the primary CTA in the first viewport (sticky bar); measure at 375x667.

title: Recorded video/voice MIME with ';codecs=' parameter mapped to '.bin' extension
symptom: Recorded wishes were stored in R2 as .bin and would not play inline in Safari/Chrome.
root_cause: extFor() matched the raw Content-Type including ';codecs=opus' against an exact table, so nothing matched and the default was used.
fix: Strip parameters (split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()) before lookup and also set the response Content-Type explicitly on read.

title: Sub-agent false negative shipped as 'does not exist': zsh unquoted --include glob and truncated output
symptom: A miner reported a capability absent from the codebase, and the registry marked a disclosure 'not present'; it was in fact in the repo.
root_cause: grep --include=*.js was unquoted so zsh expanded or failed the glob and searched nothing; the agent also read a truncated listing, then concluded absence.
fix: Quote globs ('--include=*.js') or use ripgrep; treat 'not found' as 'not verified' until a second method confirms; verify the critic, not just the claim. Restored the vision-to-watchlist disclosure.

title: Legend colours used a CSS custom property that was not defined in that scope
symptom: Status legend dots rendered transparent/black instead of their category colours.
root_cause: Legend referenced var(--x) names that the stylesheet defined under different names (candidate/defensive/known).
fix: Use the same token names as the stylesheet and a var() fallback; add a check that every var(--*) used is defined.

title: Inverted-citation restriction shipped: a study cited for the opposite of its finding (Kao, CHI 2024)
symptom: A product rule restricting a feature cited a paper whose result actually supported the feature.
root_cause: The claim was taken from a secondary summary and never checked against the primary source; the critique was itself treated as a verified fact.
fix: Re-read the primary paper, reverse the restriction, add the source line and verification date next to every research-derived rule. A critique is a claim too.

title: Invented 2-project free-tier cap presented as policy with no basis
symptom: UI and pricing copy enforced a 2-project free limit that no decision or evidence supported.
root_cause: A limit was assumed during build and then rendered as fact in copy and code.
fix: Remove the cap (or mark it as an explicit owner decision); never invent a restriction.

title: Device-connect reopen link was a dead end: approve code lost when the app was already signed in elsewhere
symptom: Opening the device-connect link on a second device led to a page with no way to complete approval.
root_cause: deviceLinkPage rendered a static page that did not carry the one-time code through sign-in, so after login the code was gone.
fix: Support /?approve=<code> auto-approve after sign-in and a Settings 'paste code' fallback; keep the code in sessionStorage across the auth step.

title: Sync blob over 2 MB silently 413'd: large journals stopped backing up without notice
symptom: Cloud backup silently stopped for heavy users; local data diverged from the server.
root_cause: A single JSON blob was pushed per collection with a 2 MB request cap, and the client ignored the 413.
fix: Move large content to the generic docs table (per-document rows, size cap per doc) and surface sync failures in the UI with retry.

title: Agent token and board state shared one file (~/.aprizely.json): state writes clobbered the token
symptom: apz.mjs reported 'no token' after a board start/step because state overwrote the saved token.
root_cause: Both token and per-session state were written to the same JSON path; a state write replaced the whole file.
fix: Keep token and state in separate files, merge on write, and never replace the credential file from the state path.

title: Mixing ?? with && without parentheses is a SyntaxError in esbuild/Workers
symptom: wrangler deploy failed to bundle the Worker with a cryptic syntax error on a chat-context line.
root_cause: JavaScript forbids mixing ?? with || or && without parentheses; the expression a ?? b && c was written unparenthesised.
fix: Parenthesise ((a ?? b) && c). Run the bundler locally before deploy.

title: Index-keyed edit persistence misaligned after reorder/delete: edits saved onto the wrong service/slot
symptom: After removing or reordering an item, inline edits were saved against the wrong row.
root_cause: Edit handlers used the array index captured at render time rather than a stable id.
fix: Key every editable row by id and look it up at save time.

title: Unquoted zsh grep --include glob returns false negatives (searched nothing, concluded absence)
symptom: A search that should hit returned empty, leading an agent to declare a feature missing.
root_cause: zsh expands or errors on unquoted glob patterns (no matches found) so the argument never reaches grep as intended; an empty result was read as 'not there'.
fix: Always quote globs, prefer rg, sanity-check the search with a known positive, and never remove capability on a negative finding.

title: Concurrent session commit swept another session's staged files (shared git index)
symptom: A commit contained unrelated files staged by a parallel Claude session.
root_cause: Two sessions shared one working tree and index; git commit takes whatever is staged.
fix: Stage explicit paths and use git apply --cached for hunks, check git status before commit, and prefer a worktree per session.

title: Two sessions deploying one Worker from the same working tree shipped each other's half-finished edits
symptom: A live deploy contained another session's uncommitted changes and broke a route.
root_cause: wrangler deploy bundles the current directory, not a commit; concurrent sessions edit the same files.
fix: Deploy only from a clean, committed tree (or an isolated worktree with symlinked node_modules) and verify the pushed commit builds there first.

title: npx wrangler deploy fails with ETARGET on an unresolvable miniflare alpha dependency (unpinned and @4 both break)
symptom: Deploys that worked minutes earlier failed with 'No matching version found for miniflare@5.20260804.1-alpha'; both `npx wrangler deploy` and `npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy` died the same way, blocking a ship.
root_cause: The repo has no local or pinned wrangler (no package.json entry), so npx re-resolved the newest wrangler whose dependency range pulled a miniflare alpha that does not exist on the registry; the ~/.npm cache had been wiped for disk space two days earlier so npx no longer reused a cached good copy. Only an exact older version resolved cleanly.
fix: Pin an exact known-good version on every deploy: `npx --yes wrangler@4.28.1 deploy` (also for `secret put`). Better: add wrangler as a pinned devDependency or deploy script so npx never re-resolves latest.

title: Currency picker button printed the full currency name and ate the whole value row, leaving no room to type an amount
symptom: In the add-lead 'Potential value' field the picker read 'TTD Trinidad & Tobago Dollar' and filled the row; the amount input was squeezed to nothing so the user could not enter money next to the currency sign.
root_cause: .cur-pick-btn renders code name (max-width:150px) chevron; in a narrow grid cell the button grows to about 230px and the flex sibling (the amount input) gets the leftover sliver.
fix: Scope a rule to the picker+amount row that hides the name span (code-only 'USD >') and gives the amount input flex:1 with a min-width; keep the full name only in the search sheet.

title: Notification bell anchored to the sidebar edge collided with the page title when the sidebar was collapsed
symptom: With the sidebar collapsed the bell sat on top of the view title (e.g. 'Start here'); the user asked for it on the right.
root_cause: .tc-cluster was position:fixed at left:calc(var(--side-w,232px) - 52px), so it tracked the sidebar edge and landed over the title whenever the sidebar narrowed.
fix: Fix it to the viewport's top-right corner (right:16px; top:14px) and add right padding to .topbar so titles and actions clear the corner; the mobile rule already used right:14px.

title: A contact with only a business name could not be saved (add-lead demanded a name, handle or phone)
symptom: Entering just a Business name and pressing Add to pipeline showed the 'give them a name or handle' toast and saved nothing.
root_cause: The save-lead fallback chain was name || handle || first phone || ... and never consulted the nlBiz field.
fix: Add nlBiz to the fallback chain (name, business, handle, phone) and update the toast; verified a lead 'Test Biz Co' saves with an empty name.

title: Add-lead placeholders carried the developer's own locale (Port of Spain, Trinidad & Tobago) in a global product
symptom: City, Country and Address placeholders showed Trinidad examples to every user, which read as pre-filled data and looked wrong for non-Trinidad users; the owner flagged 'remove those example places'.
root_cause: Placeholder text was written from the author's own location and never genericised.
fix: Use neutral placeholders ('City', 'Country', 'Street address (one per line)') and audit other forms for locale-specific example strings.

title: Two window.money definitions (ui.js hard-codes the pound sign, currency.js overrides it) so correctness depends on script load order
symptom: Callers that omit a currency rely on currency.js loading after ui.js; if the order changes or one file fails to load, amounts silently render as pounds.
root_cause: The legacy `window.money = n => '£' + ...` in ui.js was never removed when the multi-currency fmtCur-based money() was added in currency.js; the override works only because of <script> order in index.html.
fix: Delete the legacy definition (or make ui.js's version delegate to fmtCur/baseCurrency) and add a test that money(1234) uses the base currency symbol.

title: New public route /card/:slug would have been answered by the asset server because it was missing from assets.run_worker_first
symptom: A Worker-handled public page (/card/:slug, mirroring /book/:slug) would never reach the Worker; the static asset server answers first and the route 404s or serves the wrong file.
root_cause: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets serve matching files before the Worker unless the path is listed in wrangler.json assets.run_worker_first; /card and /card/* were not listed.
fix: Add "/card" and "/card/*" to run_worker_first alongside /book and /pitch; make it a checklist item for every new Worker-served path.

title: Demo tier gating honoured the signed-in account's plan, so a Pro user exploring the Business demo saw locked features
symptom: With a real Pro account signed in, the demo (meant to show every Business feature) still reported myPlan()='pro' and hasPlan('business')=false, so Business screens were locked inside the demo.
root_cause: myPlan() returned S.account.plan before S.user.plan, so the demo seed's user.plan='business' only applied to signed-out visitors.
fix: window.myPlan = () => S.demo ? 'business' : (S.account?.plan || S.user.plan || 'free'); verified the demo reports business for signed-in explorers too.

title: A versioned asset URL (calm.js?v=38) returned 0 bytes right after deploy and stayed cached, leaving the feature undefined until a cache:reload
symptom: Straight after a wrangler deploy the page loaded index.html with the calm.js tag but window.calmStart was undefined with no console error; fetching /calm.js?v=38 returned length 0.
root_cause: Behaves like a propagation-window race where an empty or old response for the new immutable ?v= URL was cached by the browser/edge. A fetch with cache:'reload' returned the full bytes and the local file was fine.
fix: Bump ?v= again and redeploy and re-fetch with {cache:'reload'}; add a post-deploy check that each new asset has non-zero length (curl -s URL | wc -c) before declaring the deploy verified.

title: Fixing the retired Gemini model default in code had no effect because a GEMINI_MODEL secret overrode it
symptom: After changing the default from gemini-2.0-flash (retired, 404) to a current model and redeploying, /api/ai still returned 'model no longer available'; the deployed secret pinned the retired model.
root_cause: geminiModel(env) = secret('GEMINI_MODEL') || default, and the deployed secret was pinned to the retired model, so the code default was never used.
fix: Update or delete the GEMINI_MODEL secret, add an aiText fallback Gemini->Claude on any provider error, and report which provider keys exist in /api/health.

title: Plans page prefixed GBP amounts with a hard-coded dollar sign (customers saw $15/month for a £15 price)
symptom: The pricing view showed $15 / $25 / $50 while the Stripe prices behind the buttons were GBP, so the displayed currency did not match what checkout would charge.
root_cause: views4.js defined `const money$ = n => '$' + n` and fed it the GBP plan amounts; no currency table existed for the plan prices.
fix: Add a per-currency price table that must match scripts/setup-stripe.mjs and drive display and checkout currency from the same selection (later switched to USD-only with Stripe localising at checkout).

title: Several destructive deletes ran with no confirmation (logged social action, team post, tax payment, cadence/calendar sub-events)
symptom: One tap on delete removed a logged social action, a team wall post or a recorded tax payment (which also puts the 'still held' figure back) with no undo or prompt, while core deletes (lead, project, todo, note) already confirmed.
root_cause: Confirmation was added per feature, not centrally; the social, team, tax and cadence handlers were written later and called their delete directly.
fix: Wrap social-act-del, team-post-del and tx-del in confirmDel with a plain-English consequence line; sweep every data-act ending in -del for a confirm.

title: Landing 'See the demo' buttons opened /app, so after the blank-start change visitors saw empty onboarding instead of the demo
symptom: The owner clicked 'See the demo' on the public landing and did not get the populated demo she had been testing.
root_cause: When new users were switched to a blank studio, the landing CTAs still pointed at /app (and the demo only loads for /app?demo=1), so the public path never reached the seeded demo.
fix: Point both demo links to /app?demo=1; verified by fingerprinting the demo reached via the landing click against a direct /app?demo=1 load (IDENTICAL).

title: Demo showed empty Activity and Milestones, and the first milestone seed used the wrong record shape
symptom: In the demo the Activity timeline and Milestones views were empty, so a visitor could not see two business features that exist.
root_cause: buildSeedState/decorateDemo never seeded S.activity or S.milestones; a first attempt seeded milestones as {id,title,...} while the view reads {name, emoji, cat, startedAt, achievedAt}.
fix: Seed activity rows and milestones in decorateDemo using the real milestone shape; verified views render them.

title: Ecom 'By channel' breakdown labelled every channel 'Other' because channel ids did not match platform keys
symptom: The by-channel list in the ecommerce hub showed 'Other' for every row.
root_cause: Channel ids such as 'ecEtsy' were passed straight to P()/src() which looks up platform keys ('etsy'), so every lookup missed and fell back to Other.
fix: Add platOf(key) that resolves a channel id to its platform (or treats the key as a platform) and use it in grouping, order rows and badges.

title: Google-Maps paste parser took the category line as the lead's city
symptom: After pasting four Maps results, one lead's city read 'Roofing Supply Shop' instead of the real city.
root_cause: The loose city fallback regex matched the rating/category line because it only looked for a capitalised phrase.
fix: Tighten the fallback: skip rating/category lines and only accept a city from the address line or an explicit 'City, ST' pattern.

title: A syntax-check loop that pipes node --check through head reports ALL OK even when a file is broken
symptom: `for f in *.js; do node --check "$f" 2>&1 | head -2 || ok=0; done` printed success for every file regardless of syntax errors, so the pre-deploy gate could not fail.
root_cause: In a pipeline the exit status is that of the last command (head, always 0), so `|| ok=0` and `&& echo` never see node's failure.
fix: Drop the pipe (run `node --check "$f" || fail=1`) or use `set -o pipefail`; make the loop exit non-zero and chain commit/deploy with && so a failing check stops the ship.

title: Disk full (ENOSPC) mid-session silently drops Edit/Write results and blanket cleanup deletes other sessions' tool outputs
symptom: A multi-line edit errored with ENOSPC; after freeing space the file had 0 matches for the new view so the work looked done but was not. An attempted cleanup `rm -rf .../tasks/*.output` removed concurrent sessions' output files; wiping ~/.npm/_cacache later forced npx to re-resolve wrangler and broke a deploy.
root_cause: The Mac disk sat near 100% (hundreds of MiB free) while caches and many parallel agents wrote; tool calls needing a temp file fail, a half-applied edit is easy to miss, and blanket cache/tmp cleanup has side effects on other processes.
fix: After any ENOSPC, free space with targeted rebuildable caches (not other sessions' tasks/*.output or npm's whole cache), then re-verify every pending edit with grep -c and re-apply; check df -h / at the start of long or parallel runs and reclaim before big multi-agent jobs.

title: zsh unquoted --include=*.js aborts grep with 'no matches found' and reads as 'not found'
symptom: Searches like `grep -rniE 'x' --include=*.js .` printed '(eval):N: no matches found: --include=*.js', leading the agent to conclude strings did not exist when they did.
root_cause: zsh expands the unquoted glob *.js before grep runs; if no file in cwd matches, zsh aborts the whole command (nomatch).
fix: Quote globs (--include='*.js'), prefer rg or a node one-liner, and treat empty grep output as 'search failed' until stderr is checked.

title: node --check rejects non-.js extensions and a check on its own line does not gate the commit and deploy
symptom: `node --check src/private/deck.js.txt` threw ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION, but because it sat on a separate line from the ship commands, the deploy shipped anyway with syntax never checked.
root_cause: node --check infers module format from the extension (.txt is unknown) and the guard was not chained with && to the ship commands.
fix: Copy to a temp .js and node --check that, and chain the whole ritual with && (or set -e) so a failing check stops commit and deploy.

title: Browser-pane javascript_tool shares one global scope: re-declaring const across calls and top-level await both throw
symptom: Consecutive calls failed with 'Identifier c has already been declared' and 'await is only valid in async functions', wasting verification round-trips.
root_cause: Each snippet runs as a script in the same page global scope, so top-level const/let persists and top-level await is not allowed.
fix: Wrap every snippet in an IIFE, (async()=>{...})() when awaiting, and return JSON.stringify of the result.

title: GNU timeout does not exist on macOS, so a guarded find scan returned nothing and read as 'no results'
symptom: `timeout 120 find ...` with stderr discarded printed no output; a reconciliation concluded there were no files until `which timeout gtimeout` showed neither exists.
root_cause: timeout/gtimeout are not installed on stock macOS and the command-not-found error was hidden by 2>/dev/null.
fix: Do not wrap commands in timeout on macOS (use perl -e alarm, or background+kill, or run plain); never discard stderr on discovery scans.

title: GET /api/images and pxb list silently cap limit at 200, so 'list everything' reconciliations undercount a 372-image library
symptom: `pxb list --limit 1000` and /api/images?limit=1000 both returned exactly 200 records; the library looked like 200 while per-project queries summed to 372.
root_cause: The list endpoint clamps limit to 200 and returns no total, cursor or truncated flag, so a client cannot tell the page is partial.
fix: Return total plus a next cursor (or honour larger limits) and have pxb list warn when count equals the cap.

title: Copying images between accounts via upload flattens generated records to kind:upload; model, seed, prompt and cost survive only as notes text
symptom: After migrating 173 images from @seven to @rhe the library showed 'Uploads 232' and 0 credits for them; model/seed/prompt are no longer queryable fields.
root_cause: The only way in is POST /api/upload, which stores pixels plus free-text notes; there is no import/clone endpoint that preserves the structured generation record or true cost.
fix: Add an owner-authorised import (or account merge) that copies kind/model/seed/prompt/neurons/parent ids and raises the cap for lossless masters; until then write provenance into notes and keep the master in the source account.

title: Two hero variants in the DOM at once gave the page two h1 elements
symptom: The V1 and V2 heroes were both rendered with one hidden by CSS, so the a11y audit and assistive tech saw two h1s and duplicate landmarks.
root_cause: Variant switching only toggled display or visibility; the inactive variant stayed in the accessibility tree.
fix: Mark the inactive variant inert and aria-hidden (or do not render it) and assert exactly one h1 in the accessibility tree.

title: LazyVideo removed the video element when autoplay was blocked, and a duplicate HEAD-probe handler aborted the request
symptom: On browsers that refuse autoplay the hero video vanished entirely; the console showed ERR_ABORTED from a second HEAD probe.
root_cause: play().catch(() => v.remove()) treated a normal autoplay refusal as a load failure, and an older HEAD-probe handler was left in app.js alongside the new one.
fix: Keep the element on play() rejection (show the poster and a play control); verify the source server-side and mark it data-verified; lazy-start with IntersectionObserver; delete the duplicate probe.

title: First git add -A swept 254 evidence files into the repo and inflated .git to 163MB
symptom: The initial commit of a new project carried screenshots and competitor captures, making the repository 163MB before anything shipped.
root_cause: Evidence and scratch folders lived inside the project tree and no .gitignore existed when git add -A ran.
fix: Untrack screenshots and competitors, rewrite the unpushed history, add them to .gitignore; keep evidence in Aprizely shots, not in git.

title: Measure script read font-size from one element and line-height from another, reporting a phantom body line-height gap
symptom: The audit reported a body line-height ratio of 2.21 that did not exist on the page.
root_cause: measure.mjs sampled different elements for the two values and divided one by the other.
fix: Read both computed values from the same node and print the element used with each number.

title: a11y.mjs and verify.mjs read the same routes.json with incompatible schemas
symptom: One harness silently audited an empty or wrong route list while the other worked, so a clean run proved nothing.
root_cause: Two scripts assumed different shapes for one shared config file and neither validated it.
fix: Validate the shared routes file on load (fail loudly on an unexpected shape) or give each harness its own file.

title: Primary CTA white on #6B7BFF is 3.56:1 and the site had no skip link, skipped headings and two sub-4.5:1 text tiers
symptom: The deep a11y pass failed the primary button (3.56:1), found no skip link on 7 of 7 routes, heading level skips, a code comment at 4.41:1 and the /start https:// prefix at 4.25:1.
root_cause: Accent colour was chosen for the dark surface only and body-tier colours were never measured against every elevation surface.
fix: Darken the CTA surface to 4.5:1, add a skip link to the shared layout, fix heading order, and lift the two text tiers.

title: Grid item with min-width:auto holding a long code line pushed the page 608px wider than a 390px phone
symptom: At 390px the page scrolled horizontally by about 608px.
root_cause: A grid child containing an unbreakable code line kept the default min-width:auto and refused to shrink below its content.
fix: Set min-width:0 on the grid item and overflow-x:auto on the code block instead of hiding overflow on the page.

title: Sticky side rail collapsed inside a grid with align-items:start, and a ul-only list reset left ordered-list numbers missing
symptom: The sticky rail had no height to stick within, and numbered steps rendered without their markers.
root_cause: align-items:start gave the rail only its content height, so sticky had nothing to travel through; the list reset targeted ul and ol markers were left with list-style:none from a broader rule.
fix: Use align-self:start on the rail with the grid stretching, and reset list styles per list type.

title: curl POST with the response discarded masked a missing endpoint and left the board at 0/38
symptom: A batch of POSTs to a non-existent route all looked successful because output was thrown away, so the live board never advanced.
root_cause: The script used curl -s -o /dev/null with no status check.
fix: Print the HTTP status for every call (-w with the code) and stop on the first non-2xx.

title: gh repo create --source=. ran from the wrong directory because the shell cwd resets between commands
symptom: A new GitHub repository was wired to the pitch folder instead of the project.
root_cause: The agent shell resets its working directory between calls, so a bare --source=. resolved against the old directory.
fix: Always cd inside the same command (cd project && gh repo create ...) or pass an absolute path, then verify git remote -v.

title: Pane viewport reports 0 width and stale computed styles, so layout measurements are wrong
symptom: getComputedStyle and bounding boxes returned zero-width or stale values while the rendered pixels were correct.
root_cause: The pane page was hidden or not yet laid out when the script ran, so layout reads came from a collapsed viewport.
fix: Front the tab, wait a frame, and trust a screenshot or a re-measured value over a single early reading; resize explicitly before measuring.

title: Screenshots go blank on very tall pages and computer actions time out when the pane is not displayed
symptom: Full-page captures of tall pages and captures after scrolling far down returned a blank slice; with the pane hidden, screenshot timed out after 5s and scroll after 30s.
root_cause: The pane does not composite frames for off-screen or very tall content, and a hidden pane produces no frames at all.
fix: Call tabs_select to front the pane, capture one viewport at a time (or hoist the element to the top / scroll_to a ref), and fall back to DOM reads for proof.

title: javascript_exec with a top-level return fails with an unhelpful SyntaxError: Illegal return statement
symptom: Snippets that end with return value failed immediately; the tool reported only the SyntaxError.
root_cause: The tool evaluates the text as an expression with REPL semantics, not as a function body.
fix: Write the value as the last expression, or wrap the code in an IIFE; keep this in the Browser verification checklist.

title: No privacy policy and no delete-my-data path although accounts store personal data (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: Users can create accounts and store contacts and call notes but nothing explains processing or lets them erase their data.
root_cause: Compliance pages and a self-serve erase flow were never built.
fix: Publish a privacy policy and add a delete-account control that erases D1 rows and R2 objects (GDPR Art. 17) with an export first.

title: About 100 source files and zero automated tests (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: The scan counted 94 to 101 source files with no test files; regressions rely on manual browser checks.
root_cause: No test runner or CI was ever set up.
fix: Add a core-loop smoke test (create lead, log call, send reminder) and run it before each deploy.

title: 39 icon-only buttons rely on the title attribute alone for a name (flagged, not fixed)
symptom: The scan found 39 icon buttons with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing useful.
root_cause: title was treated as an accessible name; it is not reliably exposed.
fix: Add aria-label to every icon-only control and keep title as the tooltip.

title: CTA keyword regex without the i flag missed a capitalised comment keyword
symptom: A post using Comment SEATING was not recognised as a call to action although the lowercase form was.
root_cause: The detector regex had no case-insensitive flag; shipped in v218 and fixed in v219.
fix: Use the i flag (and normalise whitespace) for every user-facing keyword matcher and add a capitalised case to the test list.

title: Unquoted URL containing ? aborts in zsh with no matches found and an empty fetch looks like a hash mismatch
symptom: curl on an unquoted URL printed zsh: no matches found, the empty body hashed to e3b0c442..., which was misread as a changed page.
root_cause: zsh treats ? as a glob and errors before curl runs; the empty-input SHA-256 then masqueraded as a real result.
fix: Always single-quote URLs, and treat e3b0c44298fc1c14... as the signal that the fetch returned nothing.

title: Worklog narration through a zsh variable with stderr sent to /dev/null failed silently for the whole session
symptom: Every narration call failed, the story page showed 6 findings still open, and the finished session (HTTP 409) could not be corrected afterwards.
root_cause: A variable holding a two-word command is one word in zsh, and 2>/dev/null hid the resulting command-not-found.
fix: Call the CLI directly (node path/worklog.mjs ...), never hide stderr on state-changing calls, and check the first call's output.

title: wrangler deploy from a shared worktree shipped another session's committed but unfinished feature
symptom: A deploy for a small fix also published a half-built Speak feature that a concurrent session had just committed, and an auto-commit swept the fix into that session's commit.
root_cause: Two sessions shared one worktree and deploy publishes whatever HEAD plus the working tree contains.
fix: Check git status and git log for other sessions' changes before deploy, deploy from a clean worktree of your own commit, and stage only the files you touched.

title: SendUserFile upload of a 2.1MiB screenshot returned 400 to Remote Control viewers
symptom: A full-size screenshot could not be delivered to a Remote Control viewer; the upload failed with a 400.
root_cause: The relay rejects larger attachments and the tool gave no size guidance.
fix: Downscale or JPEG-encode images below the limit before SendUserFile and report the size in the failure.

title: New token button did nothing when the browser suppressed window.prompt()
symptom: Clicking New token in Settings produced no prompt and no error in embedded browsers.
